IMP-001.title_en: Source file unreadable, encrypted or unsupported
IMP-001.title_fa: فایل منبع ناخوانا، رمزگذاری‌شده یا پشتیبانی‌نشده
IMP-001.severity: ERROR; ↑CRITICAL when the file is mapped or detected as collar, survey, sample or assay
IMP-001.logic: The reader fails on open or parse. One issue per `source_file`, naming the format and the reason. The rest of the project continues (02 §1.1).

IMP-002.title_fa: تشخیص نامطمئن رمزگذاری یا متن خراب‌شده (موجیباکه)
IMP-002.logic: N01 decode confidence < `enc_conf_min_frac`, or a mojibake signature (`Ø§Ù„`, `Ã`) survives decoding, or the Arabic-script share per column contradicts the chosen code page (cp1256 vs cp1252). Reports the encoding chosen, the alternatives and examples.
IMP-002.fix: Re-decode with the alternative encoding (mapping change → Vb rebuild)

IMP-003.title_en: Character normalisation applied (digits, letters, invisible characters, whitespace)
IMP-003.title_fa: اعمال یکسان‌سازی نویسه‌ها (ارقام، حروف، نویسه‌های نامرئی، فاصله‌ها)
IMP-003.severity: INFO; ↑WARNING when the step made two distinct raw IDs (`hole_id`, `sample_id`) coincide
IMP-003.logic: One issue per (table, field, step) from `normalisation_log`, covering N02–N04 and the N12/N13 folds: Persian/Arabic-Indic digits → Latin; `ي→ی`, `ك→ک`; ZWSP/BOM/LRM/RLM removed; NBSP → space; trim. `value` = count; evidence = ≤ 5 [raw, normalised] pairs.

IMP-004.title_en: Decimal or thousands separator ambiguous in a numeric column
IMP-004.title_fa: ابهام جداکنندهٔ اعشار یا هزارگان در ستون عددی
IMP-004.logic: N05 per-column decision. The comma-bearing values fit neither decimal-comma (≥ 95 % `^-?\d+,\d+$`, no `.`) nor thousands-comma, or both fit (every value `d,ddd`). Also flags `1.234,56` mixed with `1,234.56`. Both alternatives are kept as a PROPOSED inference; values are provisional.

IMP-005.title_en: Value not parseable for its type, or unknown enum value
IMP-005.title_fa: مقدار غیرقابل تبدیل به نوع استاندارد یا مقدار شمارشی ناشناخته
IMP-005.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR for `x, y, z, eoh_m, depth_m, from_m, to_m, dip, azimuth`
IMP-005.logic: The typed parse failed (number, date, bool): canonical NULL, raw kept (02 E3). Or an enum value matches nothing and becomes `UNKNOWN` (E4). One issue per row, `value` = raw text; aggregated to one issue per (table, field) above `aggregate_above_n`. Excludes assay `TXT` (ASY-002) and placeholders (IMP-006).

IMP-006.title_en: Placeholder or sentinel set to NULL in a non-assay field
IMP-006.title_fa: جایگزینی مقدار جانشین یا نگهبان با تهی در فیلد غیرعیاری
IMP-006.severity: INFO; ↑WARNING when a sentinel occupies a coordinate, depth or angle field (Z = −999 is a missing elevation, not a number)
IMP-006.logic: N07 counts per (table, field): placeholders (`-`, `?`, `NA`, `نامشخص` …) and numeric sentinels → NULL, raw kept.

IMP-007.title_en: Spreadsheet artefact in identifiers or dates
IMP-007.title_fa: اثر نرم‌افزار صفحه‌گسترده در شناسه‌ها یا تاریخ‌ها
IMP-007.logic: (a) `hole_id`/`sample_id` stored as a number or date (`1E5`, `MAR-01` → date, `001` → `1`). (b) Excel serial outside the accepted range. (c) Workbook uses the 1904 system. (d) Merged cells span data rows. `value` = formatted text plus stored type.
IMP-007.fix: SET ID from the formatted text; FIELD: re-export the column as text

IMP-008.title_en: Table type or header structure uncertain; table imported as `ext_`
IMP-008.title_fa: نامشخص بودن نوع جدول یا ساختار سرستون؛ ورود به‌صورت ext_
IMP-008.severity: INFO; ↑WARNING if the `ext_` table has hole + from/to and > 20 % numeric columns (probable assays)
IMP-008.logic: `detected_kind_conf` < `kind_conf_min_frac` → `ext_<name>` (02 §4.19). Also raised for multi-row headers (N17) whose unit or method row scores < `unit_row_hit_frac` dictionary hits. Lists the candidate kinds with confidences.

IMP-009.title_en: Field mapping unconfirmed, low-confidence or unmapped
IMP-009.title_fa: نگاشت فیلد تأییدنشده، کم‌اطمینان یا نگاشت‌نشده
IMP-009.severity: WARNING; INFO for unmapped columns with no resemblance
IMP-009.logic: Raised for: a `field_mapping` with `PROPOSED` status and confidence < `map_conf_min_frac`; an unconfirmed `FUZZY` match; an `UNMAPPED` column carried as `x_<name>` whose header key resembles a canonical field (similarity ≥ `resemblance_min_frac`) or whose content profile looks like depths, coordinates or grades. Persian headers are included.

IMP-010.title_en: Required canonical field unmapped or absent for the table type
IMP-010.title_fa: عدم نگاشت یا نبود فیلد الزامی استاندارد برای نوع جدول
IMP-010.logic: **Required sets:** collar {hole_id, x, y, z}; survey {hole_id, depth_m, azimuth, dip} or XYZ form {hole_id, depth_m, x, y, z} (SUR-024); interval {hole_id, from_m, to_m}, or to_m only (IMP-017); point {hole_id, depth_m}; assay {sample_id or (hole_id, from_m, to_m), analyte, value}. A missing required field makes dependent rules NOT_APPLICABLE. **Recommended:** collar.eoh_m, azimuth_ref, depth unit, survey instrument, assay sample_id and unit. Missing `eoh_m` is derived as the maximum child depth (provenance `DERIVED`), and the COL-007 and INT-004 bottom-gap results are labelled "not testable".
IMP-010.reference: Datamine Studio NPVS "validate data"; Leapfrog Geo import requirements (RB)
IMP-010.fix: Map a column; FIELD: supply the data

IMP-011.title_en: Depth unit inferred, unconfirmed or mixed within a table
IMP-011.title_fa: واحد عمق استنتاجی، تأییدنشده یا مختلط در یک جدول
IMP-011.logic: N09 evidence: header tokens (`ft`, `فوت`), magnitude vs collar EOH, modal interval 1.524/3.048 m vs 1/2 m, modal run 3.048 m. (a) The inference is PROPOSED. (b) The table mixes units: the per-hole ratio of max depth to EOH clusters near 3.28 for some holes and 1 for others.
IMP-011.fix: Confirm the inference; per-hole unit override as a change set

IMP-012.title_en: Coordinate format or CRS undeclared, inferred or implausible
IMP-012.title_fa: قالب یا سیستم مختصات اعلام‌نشده، استنتاجی یا غیرمحتمل
IMP-012.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR if a project with a DEM, map or licence layer has no CRS at all
IMP-012.logic: N11 cases: format, CRS or zone set by a PROPOSED inference; a declared EPSG that is not projected in metres, or outside the Iran set (e.g. 32038 is probably a typo for 32638); MGRS band `S` read as southern hemisphere (+10 000 km); truncated northings; inferred zone ≠ declared zone. Systematic collar errors are reported by COL-006.

IMP-013.title_en: Local mine grid without documented transformation, or poor control-point fit
IMP-013.title_fa: شبکهٔ محلی معدن بدون تبدیل مستند یا برازش ضعیف نقاط کنترل
IMP-013.logic: `src_coord_format = LOCAL_GRID`. (a) No `local_grid` definition → ERROR, and COL-005, COL-011, COL-024, LIT-004 and SPA-004 are marked suspended. (b) Control-point fit (Helmert ≥ 2, affine ≥ 3 points; ≥ 4 for redundancy): RMS > `rms_tol_m` or any residual > `max_resid_m` → WARNING. (c) |scale − 1| > `scale_tol` and undocumented → WARNING. (d) Rotation sign test: grid-converted magnetic/true azimuths must agree with gyro azimuths (SUR-014).
IMP-013.reference: JORC T1.08 "specification of the grid system used" (RC)

IMP-014.title_en: Date calendar or format ambiguous, Jalali detected, or calendars mixed
IMP-014.title_fa: ابهام قالب تاریخ، تشخیص تقویم جلالی یا تقویم‌های مختلط
IMP-014.severity: (a) INFO, ↑WARNING until the CALENDAR inference is confirmed; (b) ERROR; (c) WARNING
IMP-014.logic: After N04 digit folding, N08 applies. (a) Jalali values (year 1300–1499 or a Persian month name) are converted by `jalali_to_gregorian` (33-year arithmetic cycle) with month-length validation (1–6: 31 d; 7–11: 30 d; 12: 29/30 by leap rule). (b) Jalali and Gregorian mixed in one column. (c) DMY/MDY unresolved, or two-digit years. Corrected dates feed COL-014, SMP-008, SUR-014 and QA/QC time series.

IMP-015.title_fa: مقیاس درصد به‌صورت کسر ۰ تا ۱ استنتاج شد
IMP-015.logic: N14: in a % field (CR, RQD, mineral %, moisture), ≥ 95 % of values ≤ 1.0 and max ≤ 1.0 → `PCT_SCALE` inference, × 100 on confirmation. A table mixing scales by hole lists the holes.

IMP-016.title_en: Critical inference unconfirmed at run time
IMP-016.title_fa: استنتاج حیاتی تأییدنشده در زمان اجرا
IMP-016.logic: Any inference of kind `DEPTH_UNIT`, `ANALYTE_UNIT`, `CRS`, `UTM_ZONE`, `XY_SWAP`, `Z_DATUM`, `DIP_CONVENTION` or `AZ_REFERENCE` with status `PROPOSED` (01 §6.9). One issue per inference. The executive summary counts them, and release gate 2 blocks a release while any remain.

IMP-017.title_en: To-depth-only interval table, or interval/point table mis-typed
IMP-017.title_fa: جدول بازه‌ای با عمق انتهایی تنها یا نوع اشتباه جدول
IMP-017.logic: A table has hole_id plus one depth column (TO, DEPTH_TO), interval attributes (sample_id, grades, codes) and strictly increasing depths per hole. It is read as TO-only: `from_m(i) = to_m(i−1)`, `from_m(1) = first_from_default_m`, provenance `DERIVED`. A non-increasing TO is left to INT-002. Conversely, an interval table with from = to on ≥ `point_retype_frac` of rows is proposed for re-typing as a point table. Both outcomes need confirmation in the mapping step.
IMP-017.reference: Vulcan Isis overlapping-interval check on TO only; Surpac point tables need only depth_to (RB)

IMP-018.title_en: Identifier or field name incompatible with an export target
IMP-018.title_fa: ناسازگاری شناسه یا نام فیلد با نرم‌افزار مقصد خروجی
IMP-018.logic: For each enabled export profile (leapfrog, datamine, surpac, vulcan, micromine, deswik, generic_csv), test hole_id, sample_id, codes and field names for: delimiter, quote, path and reserved characters; non-ASCII (Persian letters, U+200C/U+200D); length > `max_id_len`; reserved names. Simulate the target's case-fold, trim and truncation; two distinct IDs that collide afterwards → ERROR.
IMP-018.parameters: per target {`max_id_len`, `is_case_sensitive`, `allowed_charset`, `reserved_names`}; confirmed per software version, no hard-coded vendor limits
IMP-018.reference: Leapfrog (IDs identical in every table); Micromine 2018 SP3 case-sensitivity fix; Vulcan Isis case-sensitive names (RB)
IMP-018.fix: Export-side ID mapping table (the source is never renamed)

IMP-019.title_en: Dictionary code lacks Persian or English description
IMP-019.title_fa: نبود شرح فارسی یا انگلیسی برای کد فرهنگ‌نامه
IMP-019.logic: `code.description_fa` or `description_en` is empty for a code in use (`n_occurrences > 0`) in a field shown in reports or figures.

IMP-020.title_fa: نقض یکپارچگی منبع یا زنجیرهٔ ممیزی
IMP-020.logic: Checked on open and at run start. An external source whose SHA-256 ≠ the stored hash, or that is missing → issue against that source, and its dependent rules become NOT_APPLICABLE. An `audit_log` hash chain that fails verification (02 §5.8) → project-level issue. Release gates 4–5.
IMP-020.fix: FIELD: restore the original file; investigate the chain break

COL-001.logic: Exact duplicates of the canonical `hole_id` in `collar` (after N12). The issue shows both records side by side, with a field-by-field diff and the dependent row count per child table, and classifies them as *identical* or *conflicting*. With multiple sources, both records are kept under source-qualified keys and both sources are named. The later import never wins silently.
COL-001.reference: Leapfrog "Duplicate Hole ID"; Datamine "Duplicate collar ID"; Discover "Duplicate HoleID"; Studio Mapper → Fusion no-overwrite (RA, RB)
COL-001.fix: VOID the record the reviewer selects, or ALIAS one record to a new ID. Never "keep first".

COL-002.title_en: Missing, zero or non-numeric X, Y, Z or EOH
COL-002.title_fa: مختصات X، Y، Z یا عمق نهایی گمشده، صفر یا غیرعددی
COL-002.logic: Flags: `x`, `y` or `z` NULL (including values nulled by IMP-005/006); `eoh_m` NULL or ≤ 0. A **zero** x or y is flagged only when it lies outside the project extent, because local grids legitimately have small values. Z = 0 on a `SURFACE` collar is flagged when |z_topo| > `z_zero_tol_m`, or, without a DEM, when the campaign median Z exceeds `z_zero_tol_m`. A missing `eoh_m` is derived for desurvey only (IMP-010).
COL-002.reference: Discover "Collar null location" (its delete-hole quick fix is not copied); Leapfrog "Invalid Max Depth"; MX mandatory header fields (RA, RB)
COL-002.fix: FIELD: supply the value; for EOH, propose from COL-007's evidence ranking

COL-003.title_en: HoleID format inconsistent or near-duplicate IDs
COL-003.title_fa: ناهمگونی قالب شمارهٔ گمانه یا شناسه‌های تقریباً تکراری
COL-003.logic: (a) **Collisions under three normalisations**: exact; case-fold; case-fold + strip separators and leading zeros (= `hole_key`, 02 N12). For each group, the issue states which export targets would join the IDs and which would split them. (b) **Naming convention**: a profile regex (e.g. `^[A-Z]{2,4}-\d{2}-\d{3}[A-Z]?$`) and an allowed-character regex `^[A-Za-z0-9_\-./]+$` applied after normalisation; the offending code point goes in `value`. (c) Prefix outliers: a prefix used by < 1 % of holes.
COL-003.reference: Leapfrog (IDs identical in every table); Micromine 2018 SP3; Vulcan case sensitivity; MX "Flagging characters not allowed" (RA, RB)

COL-004.title_en: Duplicate or near-duplicate collar coordinates (twins, wedges, re-drills, true duplicates)
COL-004.title_fa: مختصات تکراری یا بسیار نزدیک دهانه (دوقلو، گُوِه، بازحفاری، تکرار واقعی)
COL-004.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR for TRUE_DUPLICATE under different hole IDs (double counting)
COL-004.logic: ⟦`kdtree`, `drv_trace`⟧ Pairs with 2D distance < `near_dup_distance_m` and |ΔZ| < `near_dup_dz_m` are classified as: **TRUE_DUPLICATE** (identical surveys and intervals); **WEDGE** (shared collar and upper trace, divergence at depth; `parent_hole_id` or ID pattern); **REDRILL** (parent abandoned or EOH short of plan, later date); **TWIN** (separation at the mineralised pierce point ≤ `twin_max_distance_m`, declared or inferred). Divergence is measured on `drv_trace` at +50 m. Wedge pairs go to SUR-025 and CRS-010; twin pairs go to CRS-006.
COL-004.reference: Vulcan Isis "Unique collar location" (2D/3D); Datamine 3D distance; Discover; Leapfrog "Wedges found" (RB); Abzalov (2009) twins ≤ 5 m (RC)

COL-005.title_en: Collar outside licence boundary or project extent
COL-005.title_fa: دهانه خارج از محدودهٔ پروانه یا گسترهٔ پروژه
COL-005.logic: ⟦`drv_collar_spatial`, `layer:LICENCE`⟧ `in_licence = false` → issue with `dist_licence_edge_m`. A collar outside the project extent (profile `coord_plausibility` or a user extent) is always an issue, with or without a licence layer. Collars inside but within `edge_buffer_m` of the boundary → INFO "near boundary" (feeds SPA-004).
COL-005.fix: — ; FIELD: check the licence corner coordinates or the collar CRS (often COL-006)

COL-006.title_en: Swapped X/Y, wrong UTM zone, lat/long in UTM fields, wrong horizontal datum
COL-006.title_fa: جابجایی X و Y، زون UTM اشتباه، طول/عرض جغرافیایی در فیلد UTM، دیتوم افقی اشتباه
COL-006.logic: N11 detection per collar and per campaign. Signatures: geographic magnitudes in projected fields; X in the northing range with Y in the easting range; implied longitude > 3.5° from the zone's central meridian; eastings in two clusters ≈ 600 km apart; **datum mismatch**, i.e. a constant offset vector of one campaign against other campaigns, the DEM (COL-024) or the map that matches a PROJ candidate. Candidates include ED50(ED77) → WGS 84 (≈ 175 m, mostly N–S; 02 §6.5) and the NCC Iran ED50 → WGS 84 transformation (EPSG:1514, translations ≈ −110/−98/−120 m).
COL-006.fix: Per-collar or per-campaign CRS re-declaration (rebuild) or DATUM_SHIFT change set

COL-007.title_en: EOH shallower than the maximum depth in survey or interval tables
COL-007.title_fa: عمق نهایی کمتر از بیشینهٔ عمق جداول انحراف‌سنجی یا بازه‌ای
COL-007.logic: Per hole and child table t: `max_t` = max(to_m) for interval tables or max(depth_m) for point tables. Issue when `max_t − eoh_m > eoh_tol_m`. One issue per hole, naming the deepest table; measure = excess in m. **Fix evidence ranking:** driller's depth (COL-022) > last core block or run > last survey station > last sample. A round EOH (a multiple of 10 m) that disagrees with the data is probably the planned depth and is passed to COL-010 as evidence. EOH deeper than the data is an INT-004 bottom gap, not this rule.
COL-007.reference: Leapfrog "Collar Max Depth" (Fix Max Depths overwrites with interval maximum); Datamine reset-to-last-survey; Vulcan Isis "Total depth" (RB)
COL-007.fix: SET `eoh_m` from the top-ranked evidence, citing it

COL-008.logic: The hole has 0 accepted survey rows **but has a collar orientation** (`dip` not NULL). Without an orientation, COL-019 is raised instead. `PLANNED` holes are excluded.
COL-008.reference: Leapfrog "No surveys for collar"; Datamine (information); Micromine "missing holes" (RB)
COL-008.fix: INSERT a station at 0 m from the collar orientation (provenance `DERIVED`); FIELD: obtain the survey

COL-009.logic: None of the registered interval or point tables except survey has rows for the hole. Reported by type ("logged but not assayed" is in INT-011; this rule is "neither logged nor sampled").

COL-010.title_en: Inferred collar survey method is handheld GPS, planned or digitised
COL-010.title_fa: روش برداشت استنتاجی دهانه: جی‌پی‌اس دستی، طراحی‌شده یا رقومی‌شده از نقشه
COL-010.logic: ⟦`drv_collar_method`, `drv_collar_spatial`⟧ The weights-of-evidence classifier (01 §6.10, evidence E1–E11) assigns a class in {HANDHELD_GPS, PLANNED, DIGITISED} with posterior ≥ `conf_min_frac`, or the declared method contradicts the inferred one ("declared RTK, evidence indicates handheld"). Additional evidence (RC): pickup date before drilling start; Z precision coarser than X/Y; X/Y on exact 100 m multiples; fence offsets equal to the design spacing; and COL-023 check-survey residuals, which carry the highest weight. The evidence list is shown in full.
COL-010.fix: FIELD: re-survey the listed collars by DGPS/RTK before estimation

COL-011.title_fa: اختلاف ارتفاع دهانه و توپوگرافی بیش از حد آستانه
COL-011.logic: ⟦`drv_collar_spatial`, `drv_collar_method`, `dem_surface`⟧ `ΔZ = z − z_topo` (bilinear or TIN). **Adaptive band:** effective threshold = max(band, 2·σ_v,DEM, 2·σ_v,method), with σ_v,DEM from COL-025. The message gives the sign (floating above or buried below the surface). Not applicable to `UNDERGROUND` collars unless a development surface is supplied. No DEM coverage is reported by COL-025(f), never as a pass. Many collars with |ΔZ| < 0.05 m mean Z was draped from this DEM: such collars pass, and COL-010 receives the "derived Z" evidence.
COL-011.parameters: bands: W 2 · E 5 m; `bands_by` inferred method: HANDHELD_GPS W 10 · E 20; DIGITISED W 5 · E 10
COL-011.reference: Vulcan Isis "Collar on surface" (incl. surface not hit); Datamine topography tolerance; Leapfrog collar projection (RB)
COL-011.fix: Drape to topography by (i) vertical projection (depths kept) or (ii) along-hole projection (the depth reference changes, so every from/to shifts; recorded); keep and flag; or COL-012 datum shift

COL-012.logic: ⟦`drv_collar_spatial`⟧ Robust (Huber) mean of ΔZ per group (campaign, inferred method, source CRS) with n ≥ `min_n`. Issue when |offset| ≥ max(`offset_min_m`, 3.86·s/√n) **and** the offset exceeds the residual robust SD. The offset is compared with the geoid undulation N (EGM96/EGM2008) at the project centroid: offset ≈ ±N within `geoid_tol_m` → "ellipsoidal heights stored as orthometric (or the reverse)". `vertical_crs_epsg` NULL is stated as context.
COL-012.fix: **One** DATUM_SHIFT change set per group (constant N or geoid grid), never individual drapes

COL-013.logic: Within a campaign, groups of ≥ `min_group_n` collars share exactly the same raw Z text, where the expected number of coincidences at the stated precision is ≤ 0.5 (Poisson, from the Z range and decimals). Also flagged: a constant Z across collars whose DEM relief exceeds `relief_m`.
COL-013.fix: FIELD: re-survey; or the COL-011 drape

COL-014.title_fa: ناسازگاری تاریخ‌ها یا نرخ حفاری غیرعادی
COL-014.logic: Flags: `date_completed < date_started`; dates after the run date; dates before `min_year` or outside the campaign window; `collar_survey_date < date_started` (planned pickup, also COL-010 evidence); one `rig_id` on two holes whose date ranges overlap by > 1 day (double-booked rig: a date or rig error). **Rate** = eoh_m / (days + 1) per rig and method: robust z ≥ 4, or above `max_rate_m_day` for the method.
COL-014.reference: MX "Finish date cannot be earlier than start" (RA)

COL-015.title_en: Spacing outlier or clustered drilling (declustering needed)
COL-015.title_fa: فاصله‌داری غیرعادی یا حفاری خوشه‌ای (نیاز به واخوشه‌بندی)
COL-015.logic: ⟦`kdtree`, `drv_pierce_point`, `drv_composite`⟧ On collars **and** on pierce points at the mineralised-zone midpoint: (a) isolated holes with NN1 > `isolation_x_median` × median NN1; (b) Clark–Evans R (Donnelly) < `ce_clustered`; (c) cell declustering. Cell sizes run from the minimum NN to ½ the domain extent with ≥ 8 origin offsets. The size that minimises the declustered mean is chosen when high grades are preferentially drilled, but a size near the nominal sparse spacing is preferred. Issue when |naive − declustered| / declustered > `declus_diff_frac`.

COL-016.title_en: Coordinate outlier in X, Y or Z
COL-016.title_fa: مختصات پرت X، Y یا Z
COL-016.logic: (a) Robust Mahalanobis distance (MCD) on (x, y) per campaign > χ²₂(0.999). (b) A collar > `hull_dist_m` from the convex hull of all other collars. (c) Z: robust z ≥ 5 against the median Z of the k = 8 nearest collars when no DEM exists; with a DEM, COL-011 applies. (d) Z outside `z_range_m`. The issue proposes candidate corrections (adjacent-digit transposition, dropped or duplicated digit, sign) that would bring the collar into its cluster, as evidence only.
COL-016.fix: SET coordinate from a candidate correction (reviewer)

COL-017.title_en: Drilling metadata incomplete (hole type, method, size, rig, contractor)
COL-017.title_fa: ناقص بودن اطلاعات حفاری (نوع گمانه، روش، قطر، دستگاه، پیمانکار)
COL-017.logic: Per hole: `hole_type`, `drilling_method`, `core_size`/`diameter_mm` (DD), `rig_id`, `contractor` and `date_started` against the profile's required set. A missing `drilling_method` is WARNING, because CRS-002, GEO-004 and GEO-007 need the method at each sample's depth. Other fields are INFO, aggregated by campaign.
COL-017.fix: SET from the campaign default (`drilling_method_default`) when one exists

COL-018.title_en: Drilling metadata inconsistent; method mixing not resolvable per sample
COL-018.title_fa: ناسازگاری اطلاعات حفاری؛ عدم تفکیک روش حفاری در سطح نمونه
COL-018.logic: Flags: `RC_DD` without `precollar_depth_m`, or not 0 < precollar < EOH; `core_size` on RC/AC/RAB or an RC bit size on DD; `diameter_mm` ≠ the nominal size of `core_size` ± `diam_tol_mm`; `hole_segment` contradicting the collar method; CR/RQD runs inside an RC segment; oriented-core α/β in RC holes (also STR-002). Campaigns mixing methods within one domain → INFO for CRS-002.

COL-019.title_en: No survey and no collar orientation: trace silently assumed vertical
COL-019.title_fa: بدون انحراف‌سنجی و بدون جهت دهانه: مسیر گمانه به‌طور ضمنی قائم فرض می‌شود
COL-019.logic: 0 survey rows **and** (`dip` NULL, or `azimuth` NULL with `dip` > −90 + `vertical_tol_deg`). The message states the consequence per export target: Datamine DESURV/HOLES3D treat the hole as vertical; Leapfrog cannot orient it. The trace is `ASSUMED_VERTICAL` and excluded from spacing at depth and proximity tests (01 §6.3). ↓WARNING when the design (`planned_dip`) or the hole type declares the hole vertical.
COL-019.reference: Discover "Collar null dip/azimuth"; Datamine DESURV/HOLES3D default vertical; Studio RM importer (RB)
COL-019.fix: INSERT a design orientation flagged `ASSUMED`; FIELD: survey or locate the records

COL-020.title_en: Multiple collar location records without a resolved preferred record; planned vs as-drilled displacement
COL-020.title_fa: رکوردهای متعدد مختصات دهانه بدون رکورد مرجح؛ جابجایی مختصات طراحی و اجراشده
COL-020.logic: ⟦`table:collar_location`⟧ (Appendix C) or `planned_x/y/z`. All records are transformed to the project EPSG. (a) Zero or > 1 preferred record per hole → ERROR. (b) The preferred record ranks below an available one in `method_priority` (e.g. PLANNED preferred while a DGPS record exists) → ERROR. (c) Preferred vs other as-drilled records: d_h > `alt_tol_m` or |dz| > `dz_tol_m` → WARNING. (d) Planned → preferred displacement: INFO ≥ 10 m, WARNING ≥ 50 m. (e) A record re-projected under neighbouring zones or datums whose discrepancy collapses → "wrong CRS on one record". Exports always use the resolved preferred record.
COL-020.parameters: `method_priority` [TOTAL_STATION, RTK_GNSS, DGPS, HANDHELD_GPS, DIGITISED, PLANNED]; `alt_tol_m` 2.0; `dz_tol_m` 2.0; bands (d): I 10 · W 50 m
COL-020.reference: acQuire coordinate sets chosen at export; DataShed/Fusion multi-record collar location with priority (RA)
COL-020.fix: SET the preferred flag on the highest-ranked record

COL-021.title_en: Hole status inconsistent with data, or invalid parent–daughter linkage
COL-021.title_fa: ناسازگاری وضعیت گمانه با داده‌ها یا پیوند نامعتبر گمانهٔ مادر و فرعی
COL-021.logic: (a) `PLANNED` (or `CANCELLED`, Appendix C) with any survey, interval or assay rows → ERROR (phantom collar or wrong status). (b) `COMPLETED` with NULL EOH and no survey, logging or sampling → WARNING. (c) `ABANDONED`/`REDRILLED` with assays but neither `exclude_from_estimation` nor `replaced_by_hole_id` → WARNING (the same intercept counted twice). (d) `WEDGE`, `REDRILL` or `TWIN` without a known `parent_hole_id`; wedge `kickoff_depth_m` outside (0, parent EOH); wedge collar ≠ parent collar by > `collar_match_tol_m` → ERROR. (e) An extension (re-entry) whose depths restart at 0 instead of continuing the parent → ERROR. The daughter-ID regex is opt-in only.
COL-021.reference: Hole-header workflows of acQuire, MX Deposit, Fusion (RA)

COL-022.title_en: EOH disagrees with driller-reported or core-block depth
COL-022.title_fa: مغایرت عمق نهایی با عمق گزارش حفار یا بلوک مغزه
COL-022.logic: ⟦`table:drilling_progress`⟧ (Appendix C). `delta = eoh_m − driller_depth`, with source priority core block > daily plod > contract metres. Issue when |delta| > the method tolerance. For RC/AC, also tested against the last rod-length multiple. Complements COL-007, which catches only an EOH shorter than the data. A too-deep EOH creates false bottom gaps and false "unsampled" metres.
COL-022.reference: Drilling-activity capture in acQuire GIM Suite 5.5 and MX Deposit (RA)

COL-023.title_en: Collar position differs from an independent check survey
COL-023.title_fa: مغایرت مختصات دهانه با برداشت کنترلی مستقل
COL-023.logic: ⟦`table:collar_check`⟧ (Appendix C: QP site-visit GPS, contractor re-survey, RTK pickup). d_h = √((x−x_chk)² + (y−y_chk)²), d_v = z − z_chk. Normalised residual `r = d / √(σ_db² + σ_chk²)`, with σ by method class (σ_h/σ_v m: RTK/TS 0.05/0.10; DGPS 0.5/1.0; handheld 3/8; digitised 10/15). A collar "not found in the field" → WARNING. **Project level:** > `fail_frac` of checked collars failing → ERROR "collar coordinates unverified; re-survey before estimation". < `min_checked_frac` of collars checked → INFO. Residuals are the strongest COL-010 evidence.
COL-023.reference: QP site-visit verification; CSA commentary that verification must reach original sources (RC)
COL-023.fix: SET coordinates from the check survey (reviewer); FIELD: re-survey

COL-024.title_en: Systematic horizontal collar offset from the ΔZ–terrain-gradient regression
COL-024.title_fa: جابجایی افقی سیستماتیک دهانه‌ها از رگرسیون ΔZ بر شیب توپوگرافی
COL-024.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR if |Δxy| > 20 m or it matches a known datum transformation
COL-024.logic: ⟦`drv_collar_spatial`, `dem_surface`⟧ Collars on slopes ≥ `min_slope_deg` with valid ΔZ. Gradients gx, gy (Horn, 3 × 3) are sampled at each collar. A robust IRLS (Huber) fit `ΔZ_i = c − gx_i·Δx − gy_i·Δy + e_i` is iterated, resampling the DEM at (x + Δx, y + Δy), until the update < 0.1 m or `max_iter`. **Identifiability:** n ≥ `min_n` and aspect coverage in ≥ 3 of 4 quadrants; otherwise INFO "not identifiable". Issue when |Δxy| > max(`min_shift_m`, 0.5 × DEM cell) with |t| > `t_crit`. Run per campaign and per inferred method. The vector is compared with PROJ candidates (ED50/ED77 → WGS 84, wrong zone, local-grid offset); a candidate explaining ≥ 80 % of it is proposed. Δx, Δy and c are reported with standard errors, plus ΔZ robust SD before and after the shift.
COL-024.reference: Nuth & Kääb (2011) DEM co-registration, adapted to collars; EPSG registry (RC)
COL-024.fix: DATUM_SHIFT or CRS re-declaration for the campaign

COL-025.title_en: Topographic control inadequate for ΔZ tests and intended use
COL-025.title_fa: ناکافی بودن کنترل توپوگرافی برای آزمون ΔZ و کاربرد مورد نظر
COL-025.logic: ⟦`layer:DEM_*`, `drv_collar_spatial`, `drv_collar_method`⟧ Uses `spatial_layer` metadata: source, cell size, stated σ_v, vintage, `interp_rmse_m`. (a) Realised σ_v (robust SD of ΔZ on survey-grade collars after the COL-012 offset) > `realised_ratio` × stated → WARNING. (b) σ_v,DEM ≥ ½ of the COL-011 WARNING band → COL-011 issues **demoted to INFO** ("below DEM resolving power"). (c) A 30 m-class global DEM (SRTM, ASTER, ALOS, Copernicus) used as resource topography in a profile targeting Indicated → WARNING. (d) DEM cell > `cell_vs_spacing_frac` × nominal collar spacing → WARNING. (e) Vintage unknown → INFO; vertical CRS missing → WARNING. (f) Collars on nodata or outside coverage → INFO list "ΔZ not testable".
COL-025.parameters: indicative σ_v m (replaced by metadata): LiDAR 0.15; UAV 0.3; 1:25 000 contours (10 m) 3; Copernicus/ALOS 30 m 4; SRTM 6; ASTER 10; `realised_ratio` 2; `cell_vs_spacing_frac` 0.5
COL-025.reference: JORC T1.08 "quality and adequacy of topographic control" (RC); Vulcan "surface not hit" outcome (RB)
COL-025.fix: FIELD: acquire LiDAR, UAV or survey-grade topography

COL-026.title_en: Local ΔZ cluster: DEM artefact or post-DEM earthworks
COL-026.title_fa: خوشهٔ محلی ΔZ: خطای مدل ارتفاعی یا خاک‌برداری پس از تهیهٔ مدل
COL-026.logic: ⟦`drv_collar_spatial`, `dem_surface`⟧ On ΔZ residuals after the COL-012 offset: local Gi* (k = 8, BH-FDR q 0.05) clusters of ≥ `min_cluster_n` collars with same-sign |ΔZ| above the WARNING band. Classified as: **earthworks** (collars below the surface and DEM `acquisition_date` < `date_started`: pads, pits, trenches); **DEM artefact** (cluster on void-filled or edge cells, or TIN areas of flat triangles); unexplained.
COL-026.fix: Replace the DEM locally; FIELD: survey pads; or keep and flag

COL-027.title_en: Drill spacing coarser than the indicative classification spacing
COL-027.title_fa: فاصلهٔ حفاری بیشتر از فاصلهٔ راهنمای ردهٔ منابع (صرفاً راهنما)
COL-027.logic: ⟦`kdtree`, `drv_pierce_point`⟧ Per domain or prospect: effective spacing (median NN1 at mineralised pierce points, otherwise at collars) against the profile `spacing_guide_m` {INFERRED, INDICATED}. The message always carries "**indicative only, not a classification**".
COL-027.parameters: `spacing_guide_m` per deposit profile (§4, client to confirm)

SUR-001.title_fa: شمارهٔ گمانهٔ انحراف‌سنجی در جدول دهانه وجود ندارد
SUR-001.logic: Exact `isin` on the canonical `hole_id`. The issue states whether the orphan matches a collar under `hole_key` (case-fold, separators, leading zeros), which indicates a join error, not a missing collar.
SUR-001.reference: Leapfrog "Hole ID not in collar table"; Datamine "Missing collar"; Discover "Survey – no associated collar"; Micromine; Surpac "valid collar IDs" (RB)
SUR-001.fix: RELINK_HOLE through a confirmed ALIAS; or INSERT the collar (FIELD data)

SUR-002.logic: Two stations of the same set with |depth_i − depth_j| ≤ ε. **Identical values** (|Δdip|, |ΔA|∘ ≤ 0.1°) → ↓INFO with a merge proposal. **Conflicting values** → ERROR, showing both stations. Coincident depths across *different* sets belong to SUR-021/022, never here.
SUR-002.reference: Datamine/Discover duplicate depth (their keep-first fix is not copied); Oasis (RB)

SUR-003.logic: Raw dip outside −90 … +90 after the declared convention is applied. Sentinels go to SUR-020 first and are not reported as dips. Values of 0–30 in a hole whose collar dip ≈ −90 indicate an **inclination-from-vertical** convention; they are passed to SUR-005, not reported as range errors.
SUR-003.reference: Datamine, Discover (their delete-station fix is not copied) (RB)

SUR-004.logic: Raw azimuth outside [0, 360). Exactly 360 → ↓INFO (normalised to 0). Values in (360, 720] usually mean a declination or convergence was added without a modulo: propose −360. Values in [−360, 0) mean west-negative notation: propose +360. A column whose values reach 400 with no other explanation → gon inference. Sentinels → SUR-020.

SUR-005.logic: Within one hole: positive and negative dips, excluding UNDERGROUND up-holes and near-horizontal holes (−5° … +5°) that may legitimately cross horizontal. Within the project: campaigns using different conventions (`dip_convention_src`), or a hole whose survey sign contradicts its collar dip, design dip or hole type ("hole heading back to surface"). **The convention is never inferred from the majority sign when underground up-holes exist.** Evidence used instead: `collar_location`, hole type, design dip, and collar position relative to topography.
SUR-005.reference: Discover "Dip sign discrepancy"; Leapfrog automatic "negative dip points down"; Oasis negative-down default; Datamine +90 = down (RB)

SUR-006.title_fa: عمق ایستگاه انحراف‌سنجی بیشتر از عمق نهایی
SUR-006.logic: `depth_m − eoh_m > survey_overrun_tol_m` → ERROR. Smaller overruns are ↓INFO, because tools legitimately log slightly past the driller's EOH (depth counter, stick-up). The fix proposal comes from COL-007, never "reset EOH to last station".

SUR-007.title_en: First station too deep, or no collar orientation
SUR-007.title_fa: نخستین ایستگاه بسیار عمیق یا نبود جهت دهانه
SUR-007.logic: The first *measured* station is deeper than `first_station_max_m`. The message states whether the collar orientation is used as station 0 (02 §4.22) or, if there is none, that the top of the hole is extrapolated from the first station. Synthetic stations (SUR-023) do not count as measured.
SUR-007.reference: Datamine DESURV expects AT = 0; Micromine zero-depth records (RB)
SUR-007.fix: INSERT station 0 from the collar orientation (provenance `DERIVED`)

SUR-008.title_en: Station spacing too large or irregular; trace extrapolated
SUR-008.title_fa: فاصلهٔ ایستگاه‌ها بسیار زیاد یا نامنظم؛ برون‌یابی مسیر
SUR-008.logic: Spacing includes the collar → first station and last station → EOH segments. (a) Any gap > `max_spacing_m`, or > `max_spacing_curved_m` where the bracketing DLS > 3°/30 m. (b) **Extrapolated length** = eoh_m − last station > `extrap_max_m` or > `extrap_max_frac` × hole length → "trace extrapolated" (Leapfrog and Datamine hold the last direction). (c) CV of spacing > 1.0 → ↓INFO "irregular".

SUR-009.logic: Hole length > `min_length_m` and any of: all measured stations identical within 0.01°; all stations equal to the collar design (`planned_azimuth`/`planned_dip`); `survey_type = PLANNED`. The hole is counted as unsurveyed in the T1.08 statistics and in the Survey component (01 §8.1 design-only = 10).
SUR-009.fix: FIELD: survey the hole (gyro if accessible)

SUR-010.title_fa: شدت خمیدگی (داگ‌لگ) بیش از حد آستانه
SUR-010.logic: ⟦`drv_trace`⟧ For consecutive stations: **β = arccos(cos(I₂−I₁) − sin I₁·sin I₂·(1 − cos(A₂−A₁)))**, computed as arccos(t₁·t₂) from direction cosines for stability near vertical. **DLS = β·30/ΔMD** (°/30 m). When ΔMD < `min_dmd_m`, the absolute β is tested against the band value instead, so short spacing does not inflate DLS. A single station above the ERROR band, bracketed by normal stations, is labelled "probable reading error" (cf. SUR-013). Oasis curvature equivalent: 3°/30 m = 0.1°/m.
SUR-010.reference: Oasis montaj hole-curvature test (°/m, off by default) (RB); minimum-curvature practice (RC)

SUR-011.logic: Flags |Δdip| > `max_dip_change_deg` per station pair (Micromine/Discover style), **or** |Δdip|·30/ΔMD > `max_dip_change_deg_30m` (Datamine style). The issue reports which test triggered. A large change between closely spaced stations points to an entry error.
SUR-011.reference: Datamine "Large dip curvature" (per distance); Discover; Micromine "valid inclination change" (RB)

SUR-012.title_en: Large azimuth change (dip shallower than −85° only)
SUR-012.title_fa: تغییر زیاد آزیموت (فقط برای شیب کم‌تر از ۸۵− درجه)
SUR-012.logic: Flags |ΔA|∘ > `max_az_change_deg`, or > `max_az_change_deg_30m` normalised per 30 m. The difference is wrapped (359° → 1° = 2°). **Suppressed** (↓INFO context) where either station is steeper than `suppress_steeper_than_dip_deg`, because azimuth is unstable near vertical. This suppression is a GEOVALID improvement that is not described in the vendor checks.
SUR-012.reference: Datamine "bearing curvature"; Discover "Large azimuth curvature changes"; Micromine "valid azimuth change" (RB)

SUR-013.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR if `count_per_hole` ≥ 3; > 20 % of magnetic stations in the mineralised zone flagged → recommend a gyro re-survey
SUR-013.logic: Per hole, for magnetic instruments (`is_magnetic`, or assumed under SUR-018), on stations that **passed SUR-027**. A spike is a single-station excursion that returns to trend: Δ⁻ = a_i − a_{i−1} and Δ⁺ = a_{i+1} − a_i exceed `spike_deg` with opposite signs, **and** the residual from a centred rolling median (window 5) exceeds `spike_deg`. In the CROSS stage the spike is correlated with logged magnetite/pyrrhotite, Fe, MS and EMS total-field anomalies within ±`corr_window_m`. Correlated, with a stable dip → "instrument (magnetic) error". Uncorrelated, with a co-varying dip → "real deviation".
SUR-013.fix: Exclude the station azimuth from desurvey (what-if product `drv_trace(exclude_flagged_spikes=True)` quantifies the EOH shift)

SUR-014.title_fa: true / grid) inconsistency / ناسازگاری مرجع آزیموت (مغناطیسی، جغرافیایی، شبکه)
SUR-014.logic: Flags: `azimuth_ref = UNKNOWN` for a magnetic tool; a depth-constant ΔA between sets in one hole (e.g. gyro vs EMS, SD < 0.5°) or between design and first station per campaign that is ≈ the declination δ (IGRF14 at the station, survey date after IMP-014) or ≈ the convergence γ. The measured offset, model δ and γ are shown side by side. γ ≈ Δλ·sin φ reaches ≈ 1.3–1.9° at Iranian zone edges. A depth-localised ΔA correlated with magnetics is SUR-013/027, not this rule.
SUR-014.reference: Brief §4.2; ISCWSA geomagnetic reference error terms (RC); 01 §6.4

SUR-015.title_fa: اختلاف موقعیت انتهای گمانه بین روش‌های محاسبهٔ مسیر بیش از حد آستانه
SUR-015.severity: INFO; ↑WARNING for a LINEAR-flagged deviated hole
SUR-015.logic: ⟦`drv_trace_compare`⟧ Compares MIN_CURV (default) with BAL_TAN, TAN and the methods the enabled export targets actually use: Leapfrog spherical arc / balanced tangent, Datamine DESURV arcs, Vulcan balanced tangent, Leapfrog raw tangent for trenches. Reports EOH and maximum mid-hole offsets. **Includes the straight-line trace** where the source carries a linear/curved flag (Surpac): a hole flagged LINEAR but with total angular change > `linear_flag_deg` is reported with its offset.
SUR-015.reference: Leapfrog desurvey options; Datamine DESURV/SURVSMTH; AusIMM/SRK bulletin and Cardiff study on method sensitivity (RB, RC)
SUR-015.fix: — (export writes the trace type consistent with the survey)

SUR-016.title_en: Trace crosses another trace, or exits above topography
SUR-016.title_fa: تقاطع مسیر با گمانهٔ دیگر یا خروج مسیر از سطح زمین
SUR-016.logic: ⟦`drv_trace`, `kdtree`, `dem_surface`⟧ (a) **Proximity:** KD-tree on 1 m trace points, refined by segment–segment distance; minimum 3D distance between two holes < `cross_dist_m` → probable survey or collar error. Excluded: the same hole, and parent–daughter pairs above the kick-off depth. (b) **Exit:** a trace point below `collar_zone_m` with z > z_topo + `exit_tol_m`. UNDERGROUND holes are tested against a development surface if one is supplied.
SUR-016.fix: — ; FIELD: re-survey one of the pair

SUR-017.title_en: Negative station depth, or stations out of source order
SUR-017.title_fa: عمق منفی ایستگاه یا ترتیب نادرست ایستگاه‌ها در منبع
SUR-017.logic: (a) `depth_m` < 0 → ERROR. (b) In `src_row` order, depth decreases from the previous row of the same hole → WARNING. Sorting resolves the order, but a decreasing step that coincides with a change of survey date or instrument indicates a block of rows assigned to the wrong hole.
SUR-017.fix: SET depth (reviewer); RELINK_HOLE for a mis-assigned block

SUR-018.title_en: Survey instrument or type missing; magnetic status undetermined
SUR-018.title_fa: نبود نوع ابزار یا روش برداشت؛ نامعلوم بودن مغناطیسی بودن ابزار
SUR-018.severity: WARNING; ↓INFO where the campaign record states a non-magnetic tool
SUR-018.logic: `instrument` NULL/`UNKNOWN` or `survey_type` NULL. `is_magnetic` is then undetermined, so SUR-013, SUR-014 and SUR-027 run as "assumed magnetic" with reduced confidence. Reported per hole and summarised per campaign.
SUR-018.fix: SET instrument from campaign or contractor records

SUR-019.title_en: Lift or drift rate outlier; deviation from design
SUR-019.title_fa: نرخ بالاروی یا انحراف جانبی غیرعادی؛ انحراف از طراحی
SUR-019.logic: ⟦`drv_trace`⟧ Lift = Δdip per 100 m (+ = flattening); drift = ΔA per 100 m (+ = clockwise), per hole and depth band. Robust z ≥ `z_robust` within its group (rig, method, diameter, lithology, depth band). Where `planned_*` exist, toe deviation from the design trace > `toe_dev_frac` × length. The issue reports the group statistics (box-plot data).

SUR-020.title_en: Survey station with null or dummy dip or azimuth (partial station)
SUR-020.title_fa: ایستگاه برداشت با شیب یا آزیموت تهی یا ساختگی (ایستگاه ناقص)
SUR-020.logic: Sentinels are classified as missing before SUR-003/004 run. Null dip → ERROR. Null azimuth with dip steeper than `steep_dip_cutoff_deg` → INFO (azimuth immaterial). Null azimuth otherwise → WARNING. Null or sentinel `depth_m` → ERROR. For dip-only holes (acid tube, Tropari), the proposal is to carry the collar or previous azimuth flagged `ASSUMED`, never automatically.
SUR-020.reference: Oasis montaj dummy depth and undefined dip/azimuth flags; Discover null dip/azimuth (RB)

SUR-021.title_en: Multiple downhole survey sets without an active or priority set
SUR-021.title_fa: چند مجموعهٔ برداشت درون‌چاهی بدون تعیین مجموعهٔ فعال یا اولویت‌دار
SUR-021.logic: ⟦`table:survey` set key⟧ (Appendix C: `survey_set_id`, `is_active_set`). Sets are grouped by (instrument, survey_type, survey_date, source table). (a) > 1 set and no active flag → ERROR: the merged station list interleaves sets, giving zig-zag stations, false doglegs (SUR-010) and false spikes (SUR-013). (b) The active set ranks below another available set in `instrument_priority` → WARNING. Exports use only the active set.
SUR-021.parameters: `instrument_priority` [NS_GYRO, GYRO, MEMS_GYRO, EMS_MULTI_SHOT, EMS_SINGLE_SHOT, CAMERA_SHOT, TROPARI, ACID_TUBE, PLANNED]
SUR-021.reference: Multiple survey runs with priority/use flag in acQuire, DataShed, Fusion (RA)

SUR-022.title_en: Repeat or overlapping survey misclosure above tolerance
SUR-022.title_fa: ناسازگاری برداشت‌های تکراری یا هم‌پوشان (رفت و برگشت ژیروسکوپ) بیش از حد مجاز
SUR-022.logic: Holes with ≥ 2 sets or runs, including gyro in-run/out-run. Both sets are converted to one azimuth reference and resampled to common depths every `step_m` (slerp of direction cosines). Then compute Δdip; ΔA (only where dip is shallower than −85°); and the 3D separation at the mineralised pierce point and at EOH from independent desurveys. Flags: median |Δdip| > `dip_tol_deg`; median |ΔA| > `az_tol_gyro_deg` (gyro–gyro) or `az_tol_mag_gyro_deg`; EOH separation > `eoh_sep_pct` of MD. A depth-constant ΔA (SD < 0.5°) ≈ δ or γ goes to SUR-014. A divergence that grows with depth → gyro drift or depth mismatch.
SUR-022.reference: ISCWSA eBook §29.5 repeated-measurement QC tests (RC); vendor survey priority (RA)
SUR-022.fix: — ; FIELD: re-survey; choose the active set by priority

SUR-023.title_en: Collar orientation conflicts with the near-collar station; synthetic stations tagged
SUR-023.title_fa: تعارض جهت دهانه با ایستگاه نزدیک دهانه؛ شناسایی ایستگاه‌های ساختگی
SUR-023.logic: Holes with collar dip/azimuth and a measured station at depth ≤ `near_collar_m`. Flags d_dip = |dip_collar − dip_s| > `dip_tol_deg`, or d_az = |A_collar − A_s|∘ > `az_tol_deg` (only if dip_s is shallower than −85°). The collar values are labelled "design" when they equal `planned_*` or are round (−60/−90; 0/90/180/270). **Synthetic stations** (depth 0 equal to the collar orientation or to the next station within 0.01°) are tagged provenance `DERIVED` (INFO) and never count as measured in SUR-007, SUR-009 or SUR-028. The message states which orientation each target will use (the survey table governs in Leapfrog and Datamine).
SUR-023.reference: Datamine importer (collar dip/azimuth as station 0); Micromine zero-depth records; Leapfrog survey precedence (RB)
SUR-023.fix: SET the collar orientation flag to `DESIGN`; VOID a synthetic station

SUR-024.title_en: Downhole coordinate (XYZ) survey inconsistent with the collar or the measured depth
SUR-024.title_fa: ناسازگاری برداشت مختصاتی درون‌چاهی با دهانه یا عمق طی‌شده
SUR-024.logic: ⟦`table:survey` XYZ form⟧ (Appendix C), stations (hole_id, depth_m, x, y, z). (a) Tie-in: 3D distance from the collar to P(0), or to the first point extrapolated to 0, > `collar_tol_m` → ERROR. (b) Chord physics: `chord_i = ‖P_{i+1} − P_i‖`; chord > ΔMD + `abs_tol_m` is impossible → ERROR. Otherwise β is solved from chord = ΔMD·(2/β)·sin(β/2) and the DLS is passed to the SUR-010 bands. (c) dip/azimuth derived from the chords (provenance `derived_from_xyz`) and fed to SUR-003/004/011/012/013. (d) z must decrease downhole for down-holes; z datum ≠ collar z by > `z_datum_tol_m` (local vs project RL).
SUR-024.reference: Oasis montaj / Target Easting–Northing survey data type with its own QA/QC (RB)
SUR-024.fix: — ; SET the z datum offset (change set)

SUR-025.title_en: Wedge or daughter trace diverges from the parent above the kick-off
SUR-025.title_fa: واگرایی مسیر گمانهٔ گُوِه یا فرعی از گمانهٔ مادر بالاتر از عمق انشعاب
SUR-025.logic: ⟦`drv_trace`⟧ Pairs from COL-021 (`parent_hole_id`, `kickoff_depth_m`) or COL-004 WEDGE; a missing kick-off is estimated as the depth where the traces first separate by > `sep_tol_m`. For depth ≤ kick-off: (1) maximum 3D separation (1 m steps) ≤ `sep_tol_m`; (2) daughter stations are absent or equal to the parent's (|Δdip| ≤ 0.5°, |ΔA| ≤ 1°); (3) kick-off < parent EOH and daughter EOH > kick-off; (4) daughter collar = parent collar within `collar_tol_m`. Any failure → ERROR.
SUR-025.reference: Leapfrog Geo wedge warnings ("Wedges found", "Conflicting data in wedge hole", "Overlapping segments in wedge hole") (RB)
SUR-025.fix: Copy the parent stations above the kick-off into the daughter (INSERT, reviewer)

SUR-026.title_en: Trench or channel pseudo-hole not draped on topography, or desurveyed as curved
SUR-026.title_fa: ترانشه یا کانال (شبه‌گمانه) منطبق بر سطح زمین نیست یا به‌صورت منحنی محاسبه شده
SUR-026.logic: ⟦`dem_surface`⟧ `drilling_method` ∈ {TRENCH, CHANNEL} or a profile trench code. The trace is desurveyed by **raw tangent** (straight segments). DEM sampled every `step_m`: dZ = z_trace − z_DEM. Median |dZ| > `warn_m` → WARNING; max |dZ| > `err_m` → ERROR. Also flagged: segment dip vs DEM slope along the segment azimuth > `slope_tol_deg`; |dip| > `max_trench_dip_deg`; an export target configured to use minimum curvature for these holes (INFO). No DEM coverage is its own outcome, never a pass.
SUR-026.fix: Drape the trench stations to the DEM (change set)

SUR-027.title_en: Magnetic azimuth unreliable: station QC failure or magnetic environment
SUR-027.title_fa: آزیموت مغناطیسی نامعتبر: شکست کنترل کیفی ایستگاه یا محیط مغناطیسی
SUR-027.severity: WARNING; ERROR for casing or rods
SUR-027.logic: (a) **Station QC**, where the tool reports raw QC values (`mag_field_nt`, `mag_dip_deg`, gravity). B_ref and I_ref come from IGRF14 at the station position and corrected date. |B − B_ref| > `b_tol_nt` or |I_m − I_ref| > `mag_dip_tol_deg` → azimuth invalid. |G − 1 g| > `g_tol_g` → dip and azimuth invalid. (b) **Environment**, magnetic tools only. Station depth ≤ casing depth + `casing_buffer_m`, or surveyed inside rods without non-magnetic spacing → ERROR. Within ±`neighbourhood_m` of MS > `magsus_thr_e3_si`, logged magnetite/pyrrhotite ≥ `mt_po_thr_pct`, or Fe ≥ the profile threshold → WARNING. This catches the smooth, persistent bias that never forms a SUR-013 spike.
SUR-027.reference: ISCWSA eBook §22.1 raw-data checks and §19.1.1 assumptions; Imdex/Reflex EZ-TRAC QC outputs; Petrowiki (RC)
SUR-027.fix: Exclude the station azimuth from desurvey (keep dip), flagged; FIELD: gyro re-survey

SUR-028.title_en: Positional uncertainty at intercept or EOH exceeds tolerance
SUR-028.title_fa: عدم قطعیت موقعیت گمانه در محل برخورد یا انتهای چاه بیش از حد مجاز
SUR-028.logic: ⟦`drv_trace`, `drv_pierce_point`⟧ σ_inc, σ_az and σ_depth per station from an editable tool-code table (contractor specifications override). Propagated along the minimum-curvature path with a simplified ISCWSA-type model. Random terms add in quadrature per leg: (ΔMD·sin I·σ_az)² + (ΔMD·σ_inc)². Systematic terms (declination for magnetic tools, misalignment, depth scale) accumulate coherently. Outputs: 1σ lateral, high-side and along-hole errors, and the 95 % horizontal ellipse (semi-axes × 2.45) at the mineralised pierce point and at EOH. Flag a semi-major axis > `frac_spacing` × local pierce spacing, or > `abs_m`. Design-only holes use the "unsurveyed" class.
SUR-028.parameters: 1σ: NS gyro az 0.3°, inc 0.1°; gyro 0.5/0.1; MEMS 0.5/0.15; magnetic az 1.0° + 0.5° declination (systematic), inc 0.2°; unsurveyed 5/3; depth 0.1 % MD; `frac_spacing` 0.25; `abs_m` 10
SUR-028.reference: ISCWSA wellbore error model (MWD and gyro error sources), simplified (RC)
SUR-028.fix: — ; FIELD: gyro re-survey of the listed holes

SUR-029.title_en: Survey instrument calibration missing or expired at survey date
SUR-029.title_fa: نبود یا انقضای کالیبراسیون ابزار برداشت در تاریخ برداشت
SUR-029.logic: ⟦`table:instrument_register`⟧ (Appendix C) joined by serial. Flags: survey_date > calibration date + `validity_months`; survey_date earlier than the serial's first certificate (date error); serial missing; a gyro campaign without a field reference check (test stand or known-azimuth line). Without a register, one INFO disclosure is raised. The same parameterised check family serves MAG-004, DEN-006 and ASY-024.
SUR-029.reference: JORC T1.01 "appropriate calibration of any measurement tools"; gyro vendor calibration control (RC)

INT-001.title_en: From ≥ To, zero-length or negative depth
INT-001.title_fa: عمق «از» بزرگ‌تر یا مساوی «تا»، بازهٔ با طول صفر یا عمق منفی
INT-001.logic: Flags `from_m ≥ to_m − ε`, or either depth < 0. Zero-length rows are accepted only in tables registered as point/event; in sampled interval tables they are errors.
INT-001.reference: Leapfrog "From depth exceeds to depth" (row excluded); Datamine; Micromine zero-length option (RB)
INT-001.fix: SET-swap from/to when the swap restores continuity with the neighbours; otherwise SET (reviewer)

INT-002.logic: Sorted by (hole, from, to) with a **running maximum** of `to_m` per hole (01 §5.5), which also finds intervals contained in an earlier long interval. Overlap = `runmax_prev − from_m` > ε. Classified as partial, containment or full-span (a full span with identical values → INT-003). Overlaps ≤ `micro_overlap_m` → ↓INFO "precision artefact" with a snap proposal. Evaluated **within one logging version** (INT-018) and one sample set. Overlapping records of different sample support → ASY-027.
INT-002.reference: Leapfrog "Overlapping segments"; Datamine (silently length-averages overlaps); Vulcan Isis; Oasis; Surpac reject file (RB)
INT-002.fix: SET boundary (snap) or VOID the superseded row

INT-003.title_en: Duplicate or conflicting intervals (and point records)
INT-003.title_fa: بازه‌ها یا رکوردهای نقطه‌ای تکراری یا متناقض
INT-003.logic: Same (hole_id, from_m, to_m) within ε. **Scope extended to point tables** on (hole_id, depth_m, type); several structures at one depth are allowed when `struct_type` differs. Identical values → "duplicate", including mobile-capture **sync duplicates** (same values, different source record IDs or timestamps); the proposal is to VOID the newer copy. Different values → "conflict": both are kept and review is required. The latest record is never auto-selected.
INT-003.reference: Datamine (silently averages duplicates); Leapfrog "Duplicate points"; acQuire/MX/QuickLogger sync (RA, RB)
INT-003.fix: VOID the duplicate (reviewer); for conflicts, none

INT-004.title_fa: فاصلهٔ خالی در ابتدا، میانه یا انتهای گمانه
INT-004.logic: Top gap: first `from_m` > `top_gap_tol_m`. Internal gap: `from_i − runmax_{i−1}` > ε. Bottom gap: `eoh_m − last runmax` > `bottom_gap_tol_m`. Gaps < `micro_gap_m` → ↓INFO (precision). **Policy by table kind:** tables expected to be contiguous (lithology, weathering, geotech_run) → WARNING. Discontinuous tables (sample) → ↓INFO, except gaps inside a logged mineralised interval (→ ASY-008) or whose samples are pending at the lab (SMP-005, INFO "pending"). The issue states the composite effect: Leapfrog skips gaps; Datamine COMPDH absorbs small gaps, fills medium gaps with a dummy sample and ends composites at large gaps.
INT-004.parameters: `top_gap_tol_m` 0.5 (per-table override, e.g. RC pre-collar for geotech); `bottom_gap_tol_m` 0.5; `micro_gap_m` 0.01
INT-004.reference: GEOVALID v1 coverage logic; Datamine gap threshold; Discover max gaps; Micromine first FROM = 0 and continuity; Surpac missing intervals (RB)
INT-004.fix: INSERT explicit `NS` (not sampled / not logged) intervals with provenance, never filled values

INT-005.title_fa: بازه یا نقطهٔ فراتر از عمق نهایی
INT-005.logic: `to_m − eoh_m` > ε (point tables: `depth_m`). Linked to the hole-level COL-007 issue, which carries the fix.
INT-005.reference: Leapfrog "maxdepth exceeded"; Datamine samples deeper than hole; NPVS trace extension (not copied) (RB)

INT-006.title_fa: شمارهٔ گمانه در جدول دهانه وجود ندارد
INT-006.logic: As SUR-001, for every interval, point and sample table. The issue reports a `hole_key` match (join error) or no match (missing collar).
INT-006.reference: Leapfrog; Datamine; Discover "Downhole – no associated collar"; Micromine (RB)

INT-007.title_fa: طول نمونهٔ غیراستاندارد یا بسیار کوتاه/بلند
INT-007.logic: Flags `length_m` < `short_m` or > `long_m`, or not within `std_tol_m` of a profile standard length. Per domain, Spearman ρ(length, grade) with |ρ| > `rho_thr` (p < 0.01, n ≥ 100) → INFO that unweighted statistics are biased and length weighting and compositing are mandatory (short samples concentrate in high grade where sampling follows geology).

INT-008.logic: ⟦`drv_interval_master`⟧ For `ORIGINAL` samples: count contact boundaries of the lithology, alteration and mineralisation tables inside (from + `contact_tol_m`, to − `contact_tol_m`). By default only contacts that change `mineralisation_class` or a profile domain group are counted. Reports the % of samples crossing per table, and the list.

INT-009.logic: Row hashes of the value columns; sliding windows of k ≥ `min_window_n` consecutive rows per hole; windows found in ≥ 2 holes, or twice in one hole at different depths, are verified exactly. **Low-information windows are excluded:** all BDL, one constant code, or < 3 distinct numeric values.
INT-009.fix: — ; FIELD: check against the source logs or certificates

INT-010.title_en: Missing or non-numeric HoleID, From or To
INT-010.title_fa: شمارهٔ گمانه، «از» یا «تا» گمشده یا غیرعددی
INT-010.logic: Flags `hole_id` NULL or empty, or `from_m`/`to_m` NULL (including raw text nulled by IMP-005), per row. The row is kept, but interval rules cannot place it.

INT-011.title_en: Low coverage of an expected table per hole or within mineralised intervals
INT-011.title_fa: پوشش کم جدول موردانتظار در گمانه یا در بازه‌های کانه‌دار
INT-011.logic: ⟦`drv_hole_summary`, `drv_interval_master`⟧ For each hole and each table the profile expects (by drilling method and hole type): coverage = covered length / (eoh_m − allowed top gap). Coverage < `cov_warn_frac` → WARNING, and an expected table that is absent → "logged but not assayed" or the like. **Coverage within mineralised intervals** for every logging table (lithology, alteration, recovery, RQD, density) is reported separately, because JORC T1.04 asks for the length and percentage of relevant intersections logged; < `min_cov_mineralised_frac` → WARNING. Feeds the holes × tables completeness heat map.
INT-011.fix: — ; FIELD: log or sample the gaps

INT-012.title_fa: دقت عمق ناسازگار یا اثر گردکردن
INT-012.severity: INFO; WARNING for the foot-multiple pattern
INT-012.logic: Distribution of `from_raw`/`to_raw` decimals per table, campaign and source. Flags: mixed precision within a campaign; core holes with whole-metre depths while runs are recorded to cm (INFO); depths on multiples of 0.3048/1.524/3.048 in a table declared in metres (WARNING, unit suspicion passed to IMP-011); float artefacts such as `12.499999` (INFO, snap proposal).
INT-012.fix: SET snap to the stated precision

INT-013.logic: Contiguous intervals (|to_i − from_{i+1}| ≤ ε) with identical values in every mapped attribute (comments and logger excluded), in logging tables. Not run on lithology, which LIT-002 owns, nor on sample tables.

INT-014.title_en: Mandatory or conditionally required field empty
INT-014.logic: Profile `required_fields` per table and `required_if` conditions (01 §5.11 kinds), for fields **not owned by a family rule**. ALT-003 owns alteration intensity, MIN-007 mineral abundance and vein type, STR-002 the orientation reference. Examples: `sample.sample_type`, `sample.sample_method` for resource drilling, `geotech_run.recovered_length_m` where `run_length_m` is recorded.

INT-015.logic: Coded fields (`code<DOM>`) **not owned by** LIT-001, ALT-001, MIN-001, WTH-002 or STR-003, e.g. `grain_size`, `texture`, `strat_unit`, `core_size`, `contact_top_type`, codes in `ext_` tables. The raw code has no CONFIRMED synonym, so it was auto-added as `PROPOSED` (02 E5). Fuzzy candidates are listed with scores.
INT-015.reference: Brief §5; MX pick lists; Vulcan Isis field validation (RA, RB)
INT-015.fix: DICTIONARY: confirm a synonym or add the code

INT-016.title_en: Field value violates its data-dictionary specification
INT-016.title_fa: نقض تعریف فرهنگ داده (نوع، بازه، دقت یا طول)
INT-016.logic: Per-field spec in the profile, e.g. `sample.weight_field_kg: {dtype: float, min: 0.2, max: 25, max_decimals: 3, is_hard: false}`. Checks: non-numeric value in a numeric field (excluding ASY-002 codes) → WARNING; outside [min, max] → WARNING, ERROR if `is_hard`; more decimals than `max_decimals` → INFO (rounding or unit artefact); text longer than `max_len` → WARNING; `allowed_regex` mismatch → WARNING. Fields owned by family range rules (GEO-001/002, DEN-001, MAG-002, STR-001, MIN-002) are skipped.
INT-016.parameters: Shipped specs for ancillary fields, e.g. `weight_field_kg` [0.2, 25]; `diameter_mm` [20, 200]; `veins_per_m` [0, 200]; `drying_temp_c` [40, 110]
INT-016.reference: Vulcan Isis field-by-field validation (.dbv); Leapfrog invalid-value handling (silently omits non-numeric) (RB)

INT-017.title_en: Retired (deprecated) code used after its retirement date
INT-017.title_fa: استفاده از کد منسوخ پس از تاریخ حذف آن از فرهنگ کدها
INT-017.logic: For a record using a code with `status = DEPRECATED`, `retired_date` and optional `successor_code` (Appendix C), the record date is `logged_date`, else `sample_date`, else `collar.date_started`. Date > retired_date + `grace_days` → WARNING (an old legend in use, or transcription from old sheets). Earlier → INFO (legitimate history; successor mapping proposed). A code deleted from a dictionary but present in the data → WARNING. GEOVALID refuses to delete a code that is in use and marks it retired instead.
INT-017.reference: MX Deposit pick lists (values hidden, not deleted; delete only if unused) (RA)

INT-018.title_en: Concurrent logging versions (original log and relog) without an active-version flag
INT-018.title_fa: نسخه‌های هم‌زمان لاگ (اولیه و بازلاگ) بدون نشانهٔ نسخهٔ فعال
INT-018.logic: Multiple logging passes in one hole and table: overlapping interval sets differing in `logged_by`, `logged_date` or `log_version` (Appendix C) that together cover the same range to ≥ `min_overlap_frac`. Without an active flag, INT-002 is suppressed for those rows (recorded) and one WARNING per hole is raised: "unresolved logging versions". Exports and the interval master use only the active version.
INT-018.reference: Relogging with version/priority in acQuire, DataShed, Fusion (RA)

INT-019.logic: Intervals logged twice (resolved versions, or a check-log table). Both are split to common boundaries. Computed per field: length-weighted % agreement and **Cohen's κ = (p_o − p_e)/(1 − p_e)**, quadratic-weighted for ordinal scales (alteration intensity, weathering grade). Contact-depth differences of matched contacts. Flags: κ < `kappa_warn` → WARNING; κ < `kappa_err` → ERROR; median contact offset > `contact_tol_m` → WARNING. The confusion matrix feeds LIT-001 harmonisation. Check-log coverage < `min_coverage_frac` of mineralised metres → INFO. Reported per relogging geologist.
INT-019.reference: Consultant re-logging practice (RC); relog versions in DBMSs (RA)
INT-019.fix: — ; FIELD: harmonise the legend and re-log

ASY-001.logic: Per (source column or analyte × method × source): `unit_source` is CERT (certificate header rows: method/analyte/units/LOR), METHOD (method dictionary) or INFERRED (magnitude, legacy only). The rule fires for **INFERRED** units and for **conflicts between sources**. Evidence: magnitude priors; paired-column ratio (median ≈ 10 000 → % vs ppm); DL signature; method catalogue; Cu–S plausibility.
ASY-001.reference: ALS certificate header layout; MX "Method details" (RA); brief §6.1

ASY-002.title_en: Text codes, placeholders and negative detection-limit codes
ASY-002.title_fa: کدهای متنی، مقادیر جانشین و کدهای منفی حد تشخیص
ASY-002.severity: INFO; ↑WARNING when TXT > 1 % of an analyte's determinations
ASY-002.logic: Classifies every `value_raw` into `value_flag` (02 §4.9.1) and reports counts per analyte × class × source column **before conversion**. Negatives (02 §4.9.2): −x equal to a known DL (1e-9 relative) → BDL; a column whose negatives take ≤ 3 distinct magnitudes → DL-code signature; −99/−999/−9999 → SNT; any other negative stays VAL and goes to ASY-003. **A blank in a long source means "not analysed" and is never set to ½DL.** The report lists how many values each `bdl_policy` choice changed per element.
ASY-002.reference: Seequent Target acQuire import (negative handling); Faraday Copper −DL convention (RA); Leapfrog keeps negatives as real values (RB)
ASY-002.fix: — (policy applied in `drv_assay_wide`; exports write a value column plus a code column)

ASY-003.title_en: Impossible value (> 100 %, negative real grade, oxide sum)
ASY-003.title_fa: مقدار ناممکن (بیش از ۱۰۰ درصد، عیار منفی واقعی، مجموع اکسیدها)
ASY-003.logic: Flags: `value_num` < 0 after §4.9.2 (a negative real grade); `value_num` > `analyte.max_physical`; Σ major oxides + LOI > `total_max_pct`, counting Fe once (either Fe2O3T, or FeO + Fe2O3); Au > `au_max_ppm` (Au reported in % or a decimal shift) unless visible gold is logged; Σ of all reported analytes (ppm converted) > 100 %.
ASY-003.fix: SET unit (via ASY-001/004) or FIELD: check the certificate

ASY-004.logic: A Gaussian mixture on log₁₀ values per source column and analyte (k ≤ 4, BIC) finds populations separated by a unit factor: ≈ 1.5 decades (oz/t vs g/t), 3 (ppb vs ppm) or 4 (% vs ppm, % vs g/t). The finding is strengthened when population membership aligns with `batch_id`, lab or campaign (Cramér's V ≥ 0.5). **Group test** (v0.2): when grades are naturally spread over several decades the column-level mixture can miss a mix-up, so the medians of log values per batch (then per hole) are also sorted and split at the widest gap; an ERROR is raised when that gap ≥ `group_gap_decades` (no group in between) and the cluster medians are ≥ `group_separation_decades` apart, naming the minority batches or holes.

ASY-005.title_fa: مقدار فراتر از حد بالای روش بدون آنالیز مجدد
ASY-005.logic: The preferred determination is `ODL`, or `value_num ≥ ul_value`, and no `OVERLIMIT` determination exists. The UL comes from `method_limit` or the certificate, never from a global number. Also flagged: a VAL exactly equal to the UL (a `>UL` value substituted by the UL, which truncates the high-grade tail). A `>` code that already has an over-limit result is not an issue, because ASY-009 selects the over-limit value.
ASY-005.parameters: default ULs (editable): Au FA-AAS 10 g/t; four-acid ICP-AES base metals 1 %
ASY-005.fix: FIELD: re-assay by the ore-grade method

ASY-006.title_en: Stoichiometric or ratio inconsistency (Cu–S, Fe–Fe2O3/FeO, CuAS > Cu)
ASY-006.title_fa: ناسازگاری استوکیومتری یا نسبت عناصر (مس–گوگرد، آهن–اکسیدهای آهن، مس محلول بیش از مس کل)
ASY-006.logic: ⟦`drv_assay_wide`⟧ (a) **Sulphide S budget**, in `PRIMARY` material (WTH) or where CuAS/Cu < 0.1: S_min = 0.2523·Cu + 0.4904·Zn + 0.1547·Pb + 0.6683·Mo (wt %; Cu as chalcocite, the minimum-S Cu sulphide). Flag S < S_min·(1 − `rel_tol_frac`). (b) **Iron**: Fe_total = 0.6994·Fe2O3 + 0.7773·FeO (or 0.6994·Fe2O3T); |Fe − Fe_total| / Fe > `rel_tol_frac`. (c) **Partial ≤ total**: CuAS ≤ Cu; CuAS + CuCN ≤ Cu (sequential leach); AvAl2O3 ≤ Al2O3; RxSiO2 ≤ SiO2; Fe_mag ≤ Fe_total; each × (1 + `rel_tol_frac`). (d) **Element vs oxide duplicates**: e.g. Cr vs 0.6842·Cr2O3, via `analyte.to_element_factor`.
ASY-006.fix: — ; FIELD: re-assay or check the certificate

ASY-007.title_fa: مقدار پرت آماری (و نامزد سقف‌گذاری عیار)
ASY-007.logic: Per analyte and domain, on log values: Tukey far-out fence Q3 + `tukey_k`·IQR; robust z ≥ `z_robust`; top GMM population holding < 1 % of samples. Spatial outliers are SPA-001. Top-cut analysis is **suggestion only**: CV > `cv_topcut`, Parrish deciles (top decile > 40 % of metal or top percentile > 10 %), metal at risk, cumulative metal curve.

ASY-008.title_en: Missing assays in a logged mineralised interval
ASY-008.title_fa: نبود عیار در بازهٔ کانه‌دار ثبت‌شده
ASY-008.logic: ⟦`drv_interval_master`⟧ A logged mineralised interval (code `mineralisation_class = MINERALISED`, or logged sulphide ≥ `sulph_thr_pct`) without a preferred result for a key analyte. Status: **not sampled** (decision); **pending** (SMP-005 OUTSTANDING → INFO, and the hole is excluded from intercept reporting, VER-007); **lost/insufficient** (ASY-002 codes); **missing** (no explanation → WARNING). The issue proposes an explicit composite treatment (not sampled vs background) and shows the effect of each choice; silent zero-filling dilutes grade.
ASY-008.reference: Brief §6.2; Leapfrog compositing "special values" advice (RB); Geobank/MX dispatch reconciliation (RA)
ASY-008.fix: INSERT `NS` sample records (provenance); FIELD: sample the core

ASY-009.title_en: Multiple determinations per sample–analyte without resolved precedence
ASY-009.title_fa: نتایج متعدد برای یک نمونه و عنصر بدون اولویت حل‌شده
ASY-009.logic: Per (sample_uid, analyte) with > 1 candidate, the precedence ladder (extends 02 §4.9.3; Appendix C) is applied and the deciding step recorded: (1) an over-limit result replaces a primary that is ODL or ≥ UL; (2) screen-fire / metallic-screen / large-charge Au replaces standard FA; (3) a re-assay of a QC-failed batch (QAQ-018 disposition `RE_ASSAYED`) replaces **all** samples of that batch; (4) lab repeats are QC only (original kept; `repeat_policy`); (5) umpire results never replace the primary; (6) certificate revisions → SMP-010. Flags: an unresolved tie or ladder conflict → ERROR; a **partially replaced** failed batch → ERROR; original vs repeat RD = |a−b| / ((a+b)/2) > `rd_tol_frac` for pairs ≥ 10 × DL → WARNING; INFO with counts per ladder step (the T1.07 disclosure of adjustments to assay data).
ASY-009.reference: Best-assay priority views (acQuire, DataShed); MX certificate import; re-run of failed batches (CIM 2007) (RA); brief §6.1
ASY-009.fix: Edit the profile ladder or SET `determination_type` / batch link (reviewer)

ASY-010.title_en: Detection limit changes between labs, batches or periods
ASY-010.title_fa: تغییر حد تشخیص بین آزمایشگاه‌ها، بچ‌ها یا دوره‌ها
ASY-010.logic: Per (analyte, method class): `dl_value` by batch and by period. Change point: a DL ratio ≥ `dl_change_ratio` between adjacent periods, each with ≥ 20 BDL results. The issue states the consequence: ½DL substitution creates an artificial step in the low-grade tail that shows up at low cut-offs. Fitness of the DL for the cut-off is ASY-023.

ASY-011.title_en: High proportion below detection for a key analyte
ASY-011.title_fa: سهم بالای مقادیر کمتر از حد تشخیص برای عنصر کلیدی
ASY-011.logic: BDL share per analyte × domain or campaign. A key analyte in a mineralised domain with BDL share > `bdl_share_warn_frac` → WARNING (method insensitive for the grade range). Pathfinders or barren domains with BDL share > 0.8 → INFO.
ASY-011.fix: — ; FIELD: re-assay by a lower-DL method

ASY-012.title_en: Value inconsistent with the detection limit (below DL, at DL, `<x` ≠ DL)
ASY-012.title_fa: ناسازگاری مقدار با حد تشخیص (کمتر از حد، برابر حد، اختلاف حد اعلام‌شده)
ASY-012.logic: The DL is resolved per (lab, method, analyte, batch) as certificate LOR > batch DL > method dictionary. (a) VAL with 0 < v < DL·(1 − 1e-6): it should have been `<DL`, so either the DL metadata or the value (typed or converted) is wrong. (b) **Values exactly at DL** (1e-6 relative) making up ≥ `at_dl_share_frac` of a batch: censored values were substituted by DL upstream and can no longer be told apart from measurements. (c) `<x` with x ≠ the resolved DL. (d) Dictionary DL ≠ certificate LOR. Negative −DL codes stay with ASY-002.
ASY-012.reference: ALS certificate LOR rows; Faraday Copper −DL convention (RA); brief §6.2
ASY-012.fix: SET `value_flag = BDL` (batch-level, reviewer); correct the dictionary DL

ASY-013.title_en: Numeric precision or rounding pattern by batch
ASY-013.title_fa: الگوی دقت عددی یا گردکردن به تفکیک بچ
ASY-013.logic: Per batch and lab: the distribution of `n_decimals_raw` and a terminal-digit χ². (a) A batch with a decimal count different from other batches of the same method → INFO (re-typed or converted). (b) Values off the method's reporting step (step from the certificate) → WARNING (unit conversion or manual entry). (c) Excess terminal 0/5 (χ², p < 0.01) → WARNING (manual rounding).

ASY-014.title_fa: ابهام بین مقدار صفر و مقدار تهی
ASY-014.logic: (a) `value_num = 0` exactly for an analyte whose method DL > 0: zero is not a measurement, and the issue asks whether it was BDL, NS or a blank. (b) A source column holding both blanks and zeros, with the zeros aligned to whole unsampled holes or intervals (neighbours NS, no batch link). Counts are given per batch.

ASY-015.title_fa: مجموع اکسیدهای اصلی خارج از بازهٔ ۹۸ تا ۱۰۱ درصد
ASY-015.logic: For whole-rock packages (`method_class = TOTAL`, fusion XRF): total = Σ(SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3T *or* FeO + Fe2O3, MnO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O, P2O5, and Cr2O3, BaO, SrO, SO3, V2O5 when reported) + LOI. Total < `total_min_pct` → WARNING: a missing component or LOI, or an incomplete package. ↓INFO when S > 2 % or sulphides are logged, because sulphide oxidation during ignition offsets LOI. Totals > 101 % are ASY-003.
ASY-015.fix: — ; FIELD: request LOI or the missing oxides

ASY-016.title_en: Element-ratio instability between batches, labs or campaigns
ASY-016.title_fa: ناپایداری نسبت عناصر بین بچ‌ها، آزمایشگاه‌ها یا فازها
ASY-016.logic: Profile ratio pairs (e.g. Au/Ag, Pb/Zn, Mo/Re, Cu/Au, Cu/Mo) on pairs where both values are VAL and ≥ 10 × DL. Per domain, the median log₁₀ ratio per batch (or lab, campaign) is compared with the domain median. Flag a shift > 3.86·σ̂/√n_batch **and** |shift| > `log_ratio_shift_min` (0.1 in log₁₀ ≈ 26 %). Typical causes are a batch-level method change, a calibration problem or a batch swap.
ASY-016.fix: — ; FIELD: re-assay pulps of the batch

ASY-017.title_en: Method metadata missing or method code unknown
ASY-017.title_fa: نبود فرادادهٔ روش آنالیز یا کد روش ناشناخته
ASY-017.severity: WARNING; ↓INFO for declared legacy campaigns; ↑ERROR in resource profiles
ASY-017.logic: Every determination needs `lab_id`, `batch_id` (lab job), `method_id` (preparation + digestion + finish), unit and DL. The `method_id` must exist in `method` with technique, digestion, `method_class`, `charge_g` (FA) and limits. Flags: missing items; unknown codes; a source-column unit ≠ the method unit.
ASY-017.reference: MX Analytes → Method details; acQuire reference and meta tables (RA)
ASY-017.fix: DICTIONARY: add the method; SET `method_id` per batch

ASY-018.title_en: Assay result not traceable to a laboratory certificate (provenance gap)
ASY-018.title_fa: نتیجهٔ آنالیز فاقد قابلیت ردیابی به گواهی آزمایشگاه
ASY-018.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR when > 10 % of mineralised-domain results are untraceable
ASY-018.logic: Each determination must link to a `lab_batch` with a certificate `file_id` (SHA-256), or to a documented legacy source (report reference, scanned-certificate id). Flags: no link; `entry_method = MANUAL` not verified (Appendix C). Traceability % is reported by campaign, by lab and by metres inside mineralised domains.
ASY-018.reference: DBMS import batches (acQuire, DataShed, MX); Faraday Copper rebuild from certificates; Red Pine altered assays (RA); CSA commentary (RC)
ASY-018.fix: — ; FIELD: obtain certificates, or re-assay pulps

ASY-019.title_en: Mixed analytical method or digestion within one element field
ASY-019.title_fa: آمیختگی روش آنالیز یا نوع هضم در یک فیلد عنصر
ASY-019.severity: WARNING; ERROR for partial/total refractory mixtures
ASY-019.logic: ⟦`drv_assay_wide`⟧ The preferred values of one analyte come from ≥ 2 `method_class`/digestion groups. **Partial vs total** mixed for refractory or partially digested elements (Cr, Ti, Zr, Al, Ba, W, Sn, REE, K) → ERROR. Other mixtures (e.g. aqua regia vs four-acid Cu) → WARNING, with the systematic difference tested on spatially paired samples within the domain. Au charge (25/30/50 g), finish (AAS/gravimetric), PhotonAssay, screen fire or cyanide leach (LeachWELL/BLEG, partial) mixed → WARNING. Proposal: method-specific fields with the §6.1 preference.
ASY-019.parameters: `refractory_elements` [Cr, Ti, Zr, Al, Ba, W, Sn, REE, K]
ASY-019.reference: JORC T1.06 "partial or total"; MX method details (RA, RC)
ASY-019.fix: Split into method-specific analyte codes (mapping change)
ASY-019.status: NEW: JORC T1.06, MX Deposit (RA, RC)

ASY-020.title_en: Database value differs from the original laboratory certificate (incl. sample-ID offset)
ASY-020.title_fa: مغایرت مقدار پایگاه داده با گواهی اصلی آزمایشگاه (شامل جابجایی شناسهٔ نمونه)
ASY-020.logic: ⟦`table:certificate_value`⟧ (Appendix C). Certificate files (lab CSV/XLSX/SIF; PDF by user-confirmed extraction) are parsed **independently of the database mapping** into a read-only store keyed (lab, certificate, sample_id, analyte, method, unit). Join and compare after unit canonicalisation and DL coding. Match: |Δ| ≤ ½ of the certificate's last reported digit. Mismatch classes: transcription (digit transposition, 10ⁿ shift); unit (ratios 1000, 10 000, 31.1035, 34.2857); DL coding; preferred-value selection (→ ASY-009); **sample-ID offset** (≥ `offset_run_min` consecutive mismatches where the DB equals the certificate value of sample ±1…±`offset_max` in the same job → re-merge proposal); column shift (value equals a neighbouring analyte); no certificate. With incomplete certificates, a stratified random audit sample (campaign × lab × year, oversampling the top decile and reported intercepts) is exported as a worksheet and re-imported. **Project error rate** e = mismatches/checked, with the 95 % Clopper–Pearson upper bound.
ASY-020.parameters: `audit_fraction` 0.05 (min 100); `offset_max` 3; `offset_run_min` 5; project bands on the upper bound: W 0.5 % · E 1 %
ASY-020.reference: Certificate-based loading in DataShed/acQuire; Faraday Copper 10 % certificate check; Red Pine certificate verification (RA); NI 43-101 Item 12, CSA commentary (RC)
ASY-020.fix: SET value from the certificate (per record, reviewer); re-merge by sample ID for an offset run

ASY-021.title_en: Undocumented or selective replacement of original assays by re-assays
ASY-021.title_fa: جایگزینی مستندنشده یا گزینشی نتایج اولیه با نتایج آنالیز مجدد
ASY-021.logic: Samples with > 1 result per analyte. (a) The DB preferred value ≠ the ladder-implied value (ASY-009) and no reason is recorded → ERROR. (b) A re-assay flag exists but the original value is absent (overwritten) → WARNING. (c) **Selective upgrading**: in each re-assayed batch, a sign test on (new − original) of the *adopted* changes, compared with the re-assays *not* adopted. Adopted changes predominantly upward (p < `alpha`) with mean uplift > `uplift_pct` while the full re-assay set shows no bias → ERROR. (d) Repeat averaging applied inconsistently between batches → WARNING. Partially replaced failed batches are reported by ASY-009.
ASY-021.reference: JORC T1.07 "discuss any adjustment to assay data" (RC)
ASY-021.fix: — ; restore the original value (INSERT determination from the certificate)

ASY-022.title_en: Coarse-gold trigger not followed by screen-fire or large-charge assay
ASY-022.title_fa: عدم انجام آنالیز تکمیلی طلای درشت‌دانه پس از عبور از آستانه
ASY-022.logic: For Au, a follow-up result by one of `follow_up_methods` is expected when the primary FA ≥ `au_trigger_gpt`, or when the sample lies in a domain whose field-duplicate HARD median (QAQ-004) > `hard_trigger_pct`. A missing follow-up → WARNING. Where both exist, the issue reports the paired bias (follow-up vs FA), the % Au in the coarse (+) fraction from the metallic-screen report, and whether ASY-009 selected the follow-up.
ASY-022.parameters: `au_trigger_gpt` 5.0 (set to the project SOP); `hard_trigger_pct` 20; `follow_up_methods` [SCREEN_FIRE, METALLIC_SCREEN, PHOTON_ASSAY, LEACHWELL]
ASY-022.reference: Company SOP (African Gold ASX disclosure); ALS metallic screening (RA)
ASY-022.fix: FIELD: screen-fire assay of the listed samples

ASY-023.title_en: Detection or upper limit not fit for the cut-off and grade range
ASY-023.title_fa: حد تشخیص یا حد بالای روش نامتناسب با عیار حد و دامنهٔ عیار
ASY-023.logic: Per element and method: DL > `dl_ratio_warn` × cutoff → WARNING; > `dl_ratio_err` × cutoff → ERROR (precision near the cut-off is dominated by the DL, and ½DL substitution distorts low-grade tonnage). UL < P95 of mineralised-domain values, or > `ul_frac` of mineralised samples reported `>UL` → WARNING (links ASY-005). A partial digest used for an element reported as total (e.g. aqua-regia Ni or Cr in silicate ores) → WARNING.
ASY-023.fix: FIELD: re-assay by a suitable method

ASY-024.title_en: Portable XRF or field-analytical data mixed with laboratory assays, or lacking calibration metadata
ASY-024.title_fa: آمیختگی داده‌های XRF دستی یا آنالیز صحرایی با نتایج آزمایشگاهی یا فقدان اطلاعات کالیبراسیون
ASY-024.logic: `method.technique = PXRF` (or portable LIBS, field kits). (a) Stored in a canonical laboratory grade field or selected as preferred for estimation → ERROR.
