(b) Missing make/model, serial, mode, reading time, calibration or correction factors, software version → WARNING. (c) Calibration to the laboratory needs ≥ `min_pairs` paired samples per element and matrix: RMA slope outside `slope_range`, a significant intercept, or R² < `r2_min` → WARNING. (d) No pXRF QC (matrix-matched CRMs, silica blanks, repeats) → WARNING. Instrument calibration dates use the SUR-029 check family.
ASY-024.reference: JORC Table 1 handheld-XRF disclosure; AusIMM Sampling 2014 pXRF paper (RC)
ASY-024.fix: Move to a field-analytical analyte code (mapping change)

ASY-025.title_en: Probable sample swap or mislabelled bag from a multi-element fingerprint discontinuity
ASY-025.title_fa: جابجایی احتمالی نمونه یا برچسب اشتباه کیسه (ناپیوستگی اثر انگشت چندعنصری)
ASY-025.logic: Needs ≥ `min_elements` analytes with < 30 % BDL. CLR transform after multiplicative BDL replacement. For each sample i: robust Mahalanobis D²ᵢ to its downhole window (±`window` samples excluding i; MCD covariance per hole and domain). Candidate if D²ᵢ > χ²(p, `chi2_q`). Then search samples j within ±`batch_search` positions in lab processing order (`seq_no`) or sample-number order. If i fits j's window and j fits i's (cross-fit) → "probable swap pair (i, j)". An isolated candidate without a partner → INFO (vein or contamination). Samples at logged contacts (INT-008) are excluded.
ASY-025.reference: Forensic database audit practice; Sinclair & Blackwell (2002); CLR as brief §6.3 (RC)
ASY-025.fix: — ; FIELD: check the bag, coarse reject or pulp

ASY-026.title_en: RC down-hole contamination signature (grade smearing, rod-change cyclicity, wet-sample bias)
ASY-026.title_fa: نشانهٔ آلودگی درون‌چاهی حفاری RC (کشیدگی عیار، تناوب تعویض راد، اریبی نمونه‌های خیس)
ASY-026.logic: Percussion segments (`hole_segment` method RC, AC, RAB, PERC). (a) **Decay tail**: for peaks above the domain P95, `r_down = g(i+k)/g(i)` and `r_up = g(i−k)/g(i)` for k = 1…3, and asymmetry A = median(r_down)/median(r_up). A > `asym_thr` over ≥ `min_peaks` peaks → WARNING, compared with the DD baseline in the same domain. (b) **Rod-change cyclicity**: position = from_m mod `rod_length_m`; Kruskal–Wallis of log grade across positions in the mineralised domain with p < `alpha`, and the first position after a change highest → WARNING. (c) **Wet vs dry** (`sample_condition`) or below vs above the water table: Mann–Whitney on grade and recovered mass with p < `alpha` → WARNING (links GEO-007).
ASY-026.reference: RC vs core study at Cove (down-hole contamination) (RC)

ASY-027.title_en: Mixed sample types or supports without precedence
ASY-027.title_fa: آمیختگی انواع نمونه و تکیه‌گاه بدون اولویت‌بندی
ASY-027.logic: Support is classified from `sample.sample_method`: core fraction (whole/half/quarter), RC split (riffle/cone), field composite (spear/scoop over 2–6 m), re-split, channel, chip, trench, grab. (a) Overlapping records of different support in one hole without a precedence flag → ERROR (double counting); INT-002 finds the geometry and this rule resolves it, with re-split superseding composite and composites kept as QC pairs. (b) No `sample_method` while lengths are multimodal at composite lengths (e.g. 4 m and 1 m in RC) → WARNING. (c) Surface samples (trench, channel, grab) in the drillhole assay table without a type flag → WARNING; they are excluded from estimation by default.
ASY-027.reference: JORC T1.01 nature and representivity of sampling (RC)
ASY-027.fix: SET `sample_method` and precedence; VOID superseded composites from the estimation set

QAQ-001.title_en: Insufficient insertion rate or no QA/QC
QAQ-001.title_fa: نرخ درج ناکافی یا نبود کنترل کیفیت
QAQ-001.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_batch`⟧ Insertion rate per company QC type = `100·n_type / n_ORIGINAL`, computed per campaign, lab and calendar quarter, and for the project. `LAB_*` types are excluded. (a) A campaign whose assays enter the estimation set has no company QC of any type → CRITICAL. (b) A type's rate below its target → WARNING; below half the target → ERROR. (c) Resource profiles: umpire share of mineralised pulps below target → WARNING. The full rate table (by type, campaign and lab) is always printed. Whether CRMs cover the right grades is tested by QAQ-009.
QAQ-001.parameters: `target_crm_pct` 5; `target_blank_pct` 3; `target_field_dup_pct` 2; `target_coarse_dup_pct` 2; `target_pulp_dup_pct` 2; `target_umpire_pct` 5 (of mineralised pulps); `min_originals_n` 100 per campaign before (b) applies
QAQ-001.reference: Brief §6.4; Abzalov (2008) insertion practice; MX Deposit and acQuire QAQC insertion reports (RA)
QAQ-001.fix: FIELD: insert QC in future batches; for legacy campaigns, re-assay a representative pulp subset with matrix-matched CRMs

QAQ-002.title_en: CRM failure (±3 SD), Westgard violation or bias
QAQ-002.title_fa: شکست ماده مرجع (±۳ انحراف معیار)، نقض قواعد وستگارد یا اریبی
QAQ-002.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_crm`⟧ Each result is compared with the **method-compatible** certified value (QAQ-008): `z = (v − certified)/sd_1`. (a) |z| > `qaqc.sd_fail` → ERROR, batch FAIL. |z| > `qaqc.sd_warn` → WARNING. (b) Westgard multi-rules per CRM × analyte × lab, in `analysed_date`/`seq_no` order: `2_2s` (two consecutive beyond 2 SD on the same side) and `R_4s` (two consecutive with range > 4 SD) → ERROR; `4_1s` (four consecutive beyond 1 SD on the same side) and `10_x` (ten consecutive on one side of the certified value) → WARNING. (c) **Bias** per CRM × analyte × lab × period: `bias_pct = 100·(mean − certified)/certified` with a 95 % CI. |bias| > `bias_warn_pct` with the CI excluding 0 → WARNING; > `bias_err_pct` → ERROR. MDE in §1.9. Indicative values (`is_certified = FALSE`) are charted but never fail a batch. A result flagged by QAQ-006 (probable mislabel) is held as REVIEW and not counted as a failure until resolved.
QAQ-002.reference: Brief §6.4 (Shewhart, Westgard); MX Deposit certificate QC statuses (RA)
QAQ-002.fix: FIELD: re-assay the failed batch, recorded as a QAQ-018 disposition

QAQ-003.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_blank`⟧ (a) A result above `blank_warn_x_dl`·DL → WARNING. Above `blank_fail_x_dl`·DL, or above `blank_value.max_acceptable` → ERROR, batch FAIL. For certified blanks, the limit is `expected_value + 3·sd_1`. (b) **Diagnosis** of each elevated blank, from the preceding sample by `seq_no`: *carry-over* (predecessor ≥ the project's `carry_hi_quantile` grade; prep or instrument contamination); *contamination* (no high predecessor); *blank material* (persistent elevation within one blank lot: check the blank source). Spearman ρ of blank value against predecessor value, per lab. (c) Coarse blanks test preparation; pulp blanks test analysis; the message names which stage failed.
QAQ-003.reference: Brief §6.4; NovaGold Donlin Creek blank-failure disclosure; AusIMM Sampling 2014 on blanks (RA)
QAQ-003.fix: FIELD: re-assay the samples after the failed blank up to the next passing QC sample

QAQ-004.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_pair`⟧ Only pairs with `valid_for_precision` and a valid linkage (QAQ-010) are used. Per pair type × analyte × lab × period: the share of pairs with `hard_pct > hard_limit_pct[type]`, tested against `max_fail_frac` (one-sided binomial; MDE §1.9). Exceeding → WARNING. A share above 2 × `max_fail_frac` on **pulp** duplicates (analytical precision) → ERROR. The issue carries RMS CV (§1.10), the ranked-HARD curve, signed MPD and the Thompson–Howarth fit `s = s₀ + k·c` (bins of ≥ 11 pairs ordered by pair mean), so the reviewer sees precision against concentration.
QAQ-004.parameters: `hard_limit_pct` {FIELD_DUP 30, COARSE_DUP 20, PULP_DUP 10, LAB_REPEAT 10}; `max_fail_frac` 0.10 (90 % of pairs within the limit); deposit overrides in §4
QAQ-004.reference: Brief §6.4; Abzalov (2008); Long-style 90 % criterion (Donlin Creek disclosure) (RC)
QAQ-004.fix: — ; FIELD: review splitting and preparation; QAQ-016 shows which stage

QAQ-005.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_crm`⟧ Tabular CUSUM on z per CRM × analyte × lab in time order: `C⁺ᵢ = max(0, C⁺ᵢ₋₁ + zᵢ − k)`, `C⁻ᵢ = max(0, C⁻ᵢ₋₁ − zᵢ − k)`. A signal when either exceeds h. It detects sustained shifts too small for the 3 SD rule (MDE §1.9). The onset (the last index at which the statistic was 0) bounds the affected batches.
QAQ-005.fix: FIELD: review lab calibration over the flagged period; re-assay a subset of batches after the onset

QAQ-006.title_en: Probable mislabelled CRM (result matches another CRM or a blank)
QAQ-006.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_crm.mislabel_candidate`⟧ For a result failing its declared CRM (|z| > `qaqc.sd_fail`), test it against every CRM used in the project and certified for the same method class, and against the blanks. Exactly one CRM with |z| < `match_sd`, agreeing on ≥ `min_analytes_match` certified analytes where available → WARNING "probable mislabel X → Y". A match to a blank → "CRM/blank swap". No match, but the value is consistent with neighbouring routine samples → handed to QAQ-014 (sample swap).
QAQ-006.reference: Brief §6.4; Oasis montaj standards extraction notes (RA)

QAQ-007.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_pair` where `pair_type = UMPIRE`⟧ Primary-lab vs umpire-lab pairs, `valid_for_precision` only. RMA regression (slope, intercept, bootstrap CI), Wilcoxon signed-rank on `log(b/a)`, and the mean relative difference, overall and by grade class (below cut-off, cut-off to median, above median). |bias| ≥ `bias_warn_pct` with p < `alpha` → WARNING; ≥ `bias_err_pct` → ERROR. Also flags umpire selections that miss the grade range (< `min_above_cutoff_frac` of pairs above cut-off), since a low-grade-only umpire programme cannot test bias at ore grade.
QAQ-007.fix: — ; FIELD: investigate method and calibration. A correction is applied only with CP approval, as a documented change set.

QAQ-008.title_en: CRM identity or certified value unresolved, or certified for an incompatible method
QAQ-008.title_fa: هویت یا مقدار تأییدشدهٔ ماده مرجع نامشخص یا ناسازگار با روش آنالیز
QAQ-008.logic: Runs **before** QAQ-002. Each company CRM result must resolve to `crm_id` (through `crm.synonyms`) and to a `crm_value` row for (analyte, method class compatible with the determination's `method.digestion`). Flags: unknown or blank `crm_id`; analyte not certified for that CRM; certified value only for a different digestion class (partial vs total); `sd_1` missing; unit mismatch → ERROR. An indicative value used as certified → WARNING. Without this rule, comparing an aqua-regia result with a total-digestion certified value manufactures a false low bias.
QAQ-008.reference: MX Deposit Reference Material / Certified Results lists; acQuire QAQC reference tables; Oasis montaj (RA)
QAQ-008.fix: DICTIONARY: add CRM certificate values; SET `crm_id`

QAQ-009.title_en: CRMs not fit for purpose (grade coverage, matrix, certification)
QAQ-009.title_fa: مواد مرجع نامتناسب با هدف (پوشش عیاری، ماتریس، گواهی)
QAQ-009.logic: Per key analyte and period. (a) **Grade coverage:** the profile `cutoff`, the mineralised-domain median (declustered when available) and P90. At least one CRM in use must lie within ±`band_tol_frac` of each; each missing band → WARNING. All CRMs > 3 × P90 or < ½ × cut-off → ERROR. (b) **Matrix:** no matrix-matched CRM (oxide, transition, sulphide, silicate, laterite, Fe ore) for a material class holding > `matrix_share_min_frac` of mineralised metres → WARNING. (c) **Certification:** in-house CRMs (`is_in_house`) with `n_labs` < `min_round_robin_labs_n` → WARNING. (d) Regression of CRM bias on certified grade → INFO with the slope, exposing grade-dependent bias.
QAQ-009.reference: JORC T1.06; OREAS matrix-matched CRM guidance; practitioner practice (RA, RC)
QAQ-009.fix: FIELD: procure matrix-matched CRMs at the missing grades

QAQ-010.title_fa: پیوند نامعتبر نمونهٔ تکراری با نمونهٔ اصلی
QAQ-010.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR when > 10 % of a type's pairs are invalid
QAQ-010.logic: Each `*_DUP`, `UMPIRE` and `LAB_REPEAT` must reference a parent. Flags: parent missing or unknown; parent is itself a QC sample; parent in another hole; a FIELD duplicate whose interval differs from its parent's by > `interval_tol_m`; parent with no result for the analyte; a PULP or COARSE duplicate in a different lab job from its parent and not typed `UMPIRE`; a type inconsistent with the preparation codes. Invalid pairs are excluded from QAQ-004, QAQ-016 and QAQ-017 and counted.
QAQ-010.reference: acQuire Sample/CheckSample; Datamine CCLAS duplicate linkage; MX Deposit sample types (RA)

QAQ-011.title_en: CRM results implausibly precise or identical to the certified value
QAQ-011.title_fa: نتایج ماده مرجع با دقت غیرواقعی یا برابر با مقدار تأییدشده
QAQ-011.logic: Per CRM × analyte × lab × method with n ≥ `min_n`. (a) `s_obs / sd_1` < `sd_ratio_min` → WARNING (the lab recognises the CRM, results were copied from the certificate, or back-filled). (b) ≥ `identical_max` results exactly equal to the certified value at certified precision, or > 20 % of results identical to one another → ERROR (expected values substituted). (c) Zero failures over > 100 insertions while routine duplicates show poor precision → INFO. A reviewer may accept a low ratio for a very homogeneous CRM with a conservative between-lab SD (`sd_kind = BETWEEN_LAB`), with the reason recorded. MDE §1.9.
QAQ-011.reference: Forensic QA/QC review practice (RC; domain knowledge)
QAQ-011.fix: FIELD: confirm blind submission; obtain raw instrument output

QAQ-012.title_en: QC samples not blind, or in predictable positions
QAQ-012.title_fa: نمونه‌های کنترلی غیرکور یا در جایگاه قابل‌پیش‌بینی
QAQ-012.logic: (a) QC sample IDs with distinctive prefixes or suffixes (`STD`, `BLK`, `DUP`, CRM names) or outside the routine number series → WARNING. (b) For each QC type, test residues of the sample number modulo each of `moduli` and the position within the batch. ≥ `residue_share` of one type on one residue → WARNING "fixed insertion slot". (c) Field duplicates numbered consecutively with their originals (n, n+1) in > 80 % of pairs → INFO. (d) CRMs recorded as submitted in supplier sachets → INFO.
QAQ-012.reference: AusIMM Sampling 2008 "Considerations on QA/QC and sample security"; CIM Exploration BPG 2018 (RC)
QAQ-012.fix: FIELD: randomise insertion positions within the routine ticket series

QAQ-013.title_en: QC sample position inconsistent with the planned insertion schedule
QAQ-013.title_fa: مغایرت جایگاه نمونهٔ کنترلی با برنامهٔ درج
QAQ-013.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR when a QC slot holds a sample with depths (→ CRS-008)
QAQ-013.logic: ⟦`table:qc_schedule`⟧ (Appendix C), or a modulo or regex rule. If none is supplied, the schedule is inferred from the modal spacing of QC numbers per campaign and shown as an inference. Planned vs actual `sample_type` per ticket. Flags: a QC sample where a routine sample was expected, and the reverse; the wrong QC type (e.g. a blank in a CRM slot); the wrong CRM against the plan; tickets skipped or reused within a dispatch.
QAQ-013.reference: Datamine CCLAS job schemes; acQuire and MX Deposit ticket allocation (RA)

QAQ-014.title_en: Probable sample swap or sequence shift detected with QC markers
QAQ-014.title_fa: احتمال جابجایی نمونه یا لغزش توالی شماره‌ها بر پایهٔ نشانگرهای کنترلی
QAQ-014.logic: (a) **Pair swap:** QC sample q at position i and routine neighbour r at i ± 1. ERROR "probable swap q ↔ r" when q fails (QAQ-002 or QAQ-003), r's value is within `k_sd`·SD of q's expected value, and q's value fits r's downhole neighbours (|log₁₀ ratio| to the median of r ± 2 < 0.5). (b) **Sequence shift:** within a batch, `S(lag)` = the share of QC positions that pass when tested against `v(i+lag)`, for lag in [−`max_lag`, +`max_lag`]. A non-zero lag with `S(lag)` > `S(0)` and `S(lag)` ≥ `shift_score_min_frac` → ERROR "sequence shifted by lag" for that sample range. (c) A duplicate that matches the adjacent original far better than its own parent (ratio of relative differences < 0.25) → WARNING.
QAQ-014.reference: Micromine Geobank Sample Tracker reconciliation; Datamine SABLE TrackSamp (RA; detection algorithm is domain knowledge)
QAQ-014.fix: DRAFT change set re-aligning the results by the detected lag, applied only after lab confirmation; FIELD: ask the lab to confirm the sequence

QAQ-015.title_en: Laboratory internal QC missing or failing
QAQ-015.title_fa: نبود یا شکست کنترل کیفیت داخلی آزمایشگاه
QAQ-015.logic: ⟦`LAB_CRM`, `LAB_BLANK`, `LAB_REPEAT` rows from the lab QC certificate⟧ Per batch: no lab QC → WARNING; a lab CRM outside the lab's own target range; a lab blank above its limit; a lab repeat RPD (= 100·|a−b|/((a+b)/2)) outside the LOR-dependent band → WARNING. Cross-tabulated with company QC per batch: *company CRM fails, lab QC passes* → a sample identity or preparation problem upstream of the instrument (see QAQ-014, SMP-007); *both fail* → an analytical problem (re-assay pulps).
QAQ-015.parameters: RPD bands: mean < 10 × LOR, no limit; 10–20 × LOR, ≤ 50 %; > 20 × LOR, ≤ 20 % (editable); lab target ranges read from the certificate
QAQ-015.reference: ALS QC certificate layout; MX Deposit "Controls" filter including lab controls (RA)
QAQ-015.fix: FIELD: request the lab QC certificate

QAQ-016.title_en: Duplicate precision hierarchy violated; error-variance partition
QAQ-016.title_fa: نقض سلسله‌مراتب دقت نمونه‌های تکراری؛ تفکیک واریانس خطا
QAQ-016.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_pair`⟧ RMS CV (§1.10) per duplicate type × analyte × lab × period on informative pairs, with bootstrap CIs. Expected: CV_field ≥ CV_coarse ≥ CV_pulp. An inversion of ≥ 1.5× with non-overlapping CIs → WARNING (types mislabelled, protocol not followed, pulps re-pulverised). Always reports the **partition of relative error variance**: analytical = CV²_pulp; preparation = CV²_coarse − CV²_pulp; primary sampling = CV²_field − CV²_coarse. Negative components are clipped to 0 and flagged. The partition shows whether to invest in sampling, preparation or analysis, and is compared with the QAQ-021 prediction.

QAQ-017.title_en: Systematic bias between original and duplicate (splitter or sub-sampling bias)
QAQ-017.title_fa: اریبی سیستماتیک بین نمونهٔ اصلی و تکراری
QAQ-017.logic: Per duplicate type × analyte × lab with ≥ `min_pairs` informative pairs: Wilcoxon signed-rank on `log(a/b)`, RMA slope with bootstrap CI, and signed MPD. p < `alpha` with |MPD| > `mpd_thr_frac`·100, or an RMA slope CI excluding 1 → WARNING. Repeated by grade class. Interpretation hints by type: RC field duplicate → riffle or cone splitter, or moisture; half core → selective choice of the better half or a cut-line bias; coarse or pulp → preparation contamination. QAQ-004 covers precision; this rule covers bias.
QAQ-017.reference: Abzalov (2008) RMA on paired data; consultant RC-splitter audits (RC)
QAQ-017.fix: FIELD: audit the splitter or core-cutting practice

QAQ-018.title_en: QC failure without a documented disposition
QAQ-018.title_fa: شکست کنترلی بدون تعیین تکلیف مستند
QAQ-018.logic: ⟦`table:qc_disposition`⟧ (Appendix C). Every batch failure raised by QAQ-002, -003, -004, -005 or -015 needs a disposition: `RE_ASSAYED` (linked to a re-assay job that exists and passes), `ACCEPTED_WITH_FAILURE` (reason, reviewer and date mandatory), or `REJECTED` (batch results excluded or flagged). Flags: no disposition after `max_days`; ACCEPTED_WITH_FAILURE without a reason; RE_ASSAYED with no re-assay job; a batch with ≥ `n_accept_warn` failures accepted. Reports the % of failures with a disposition, by period and lab. ASY-009 step 3 and ASY-021 read the `RE_ASSAYED` link.
QAQ-018.reference: MX Deposit per-result certificate QC statuses (RA)

QAQ-019.title_en: Batch without company QC, and batch status summary
QAQ-019.title_fa: بچ فاقد کنترل کیفیت شرکت و خلاصهٔ وضعیت بچ‌ها
QAQ-019.logic: ⟦`drv_qaqc_batch`⟧ Batch status: `PASS` (all company QC pass), `FAIL` (any CRM or blank failure, or a QAQ-014 shift), `REVIEW` (WARNING-level findings only). A batch with no company QC whose samples enter the estimation set → WARNING "unverifiable batch". One INFO issue carries the project batch table and the **re-assay list** (FAIL batches without a passing `RE_ASSAYED` disposition), exportable as XLSX.
QAQ-019.reference: Brief §6.4 ("batch-level pass/fail summary and list of batches requiring re-assay")

QAQ-020.title_en: Sample-preparation sizing QC failing or absent
QAQ-020.title_fa: شکست یا نبود آزمون دانه‌بندی در آماده‌سازی
QAQ-020.logic: ⟦`table:prep_qc`⟧ (Appendix C: batch, stage, screen size, % passing). Per batch: crush < `crush_spec` or pulverise < `pulv_spec` → WARNING (specs editable per lab package, e.g. 90 % < 2 mm for coarse-gold protocols). Fewer tests than `freq` per samples prepared → INFO. A falling rolling pass rate → WARNING (equipment wear). A batch failing sizing and also failing coarse or pulp duplicate precision (QAQ-004) is reported as one combined finding.
QAQ-020.reference: ALS PREP-31 specification and Sample Preparation QC tech note (RA, RC)
QAQ-020.fix: FIELD: request sizing tests; re-pulverise failed pulps

QAQ-021.title_en: Sub-sampling protocol fundamental sampling error exceeds tolerance
QAQ-021.title_fa: خطای بنیادی نمونه‌برداری پروتکل بیش از حد مجاز
QAQ-021.logic: ⟦`table:sampling_protocol`⟧ (Appendix C: stages with mass and nominal top size). Per stage (François-Bongarçon form of Gy's formula): `σ²_rel = K·d^α·(1/M_S − 1/M_L)`, with d the nominal top size in cm and masses in g. K and α come from heterogeneity tests or the commodity defaults of the profile. Total `σ_FSE = √Σσ²_stage`. A stage σ > `tol_stage` or a total above the commodity tolerance → WARNING. The predicted total is compared with the observed field-duplicate RMS CV (QAQ-016); observed ≫ predicted points to an under-estimated K or other sampling errors (segregation, delimitation, extraction). Produces a sampling nomogram figure.
QAQ-021.parameters: `alpha` 1.5 (low-grade Au default); K per commodity profile (to be calibrated); `tol_stage` 0.10; `tol_total` {base metals, Fe: 0.10; Au: 0.20}
QAQ-021.reference: Gy sampling theory (François-Bongarçon modification); Pitard; JORC T1.05 "sample sizes appropriate to the grain size" (RC)
QAQ-021.fix: FIELD: revise the protocol (larger mass or finer crush before splitting)

QAQ-022.title_fa: عدم ثبت اعتباربخشی یا استقلال آزمایشگاه
QAQ-022.logic: Laboratory register (Appendix C: `lab.accreditation_scope`, `accreditation_valid_from/to`, `relationship_to_issuer`). Flags: an assay lab with no register entry → WARNING; a method outside the accredited scope, or an assay date outside accreditation validity → WARNING; a non-independent lab producing > `independence_share_frac` of resource-domain assays with no umpire programme → WARNING; preparation by issuer personnel → INFO (a disclosure item).
QAQ-022.reference: NI 43-101F1 Item 11 (laboratory name, relationship to the issuer, certification); JORC T1.06 (RC; Form text not retrieved)
QAQ-022.fix: FIELD: obtain the ISO/IEC 17025 certificate and its scope

LIT-001.title_en: Lithology code not in the dictionary, or synonym variants
LIT-001.title_fa: کد سنگ‌شناسی خارج از فرهنگ کدها یا گونه‌های هم‌معنا
LIT-001.logic: Inventory of raw codes with counts, metres, holes and loggers (always reported, INFO). (a) A raw code without a CONFIRMED mapping in `LITH`, auto-added as PROPOSED → WARNING. (b) **Synonym clusters:** after case, space and punctuation folding (02 §6.6), the Persian–English transliteration and abbreviation tables, Levenshtein ≤ `lev_max` (1 for codes ≤ 4 characters, 2 for longer) or Jaro–Winkler ≥ `jw_min`. A cluster with ≥ 2 raw variants → WARNING proposing one harmonised code. (c) A code absent from the project legend (`code.source ≠ LEGEND` when a legend was loaded) → WARNING. Applies equally to `strat_unit` (domain `STRAT`).
LIT-001.reference: Brief §7; legend validation in Leapfrog and Vulcan (RB)

LIT-002.title_en: Thin interval or unmerged consecutive identical units
LIT-002.title_fa: بازهٔ بسیار نازک یا واحدهای یکسان پیاپی ادغام‌نشده
LIT-002.logic: (a) `length_m < thin_m`, skipping `thin_exempt_codes` (veins, dykelets, gouge) → INFO. A hole whose share of thin intervals exceeds `thin_share_frac` → WARNING "over-splitting". (b) Consecutive intervals (|to_i − from_{i+1}| ≤ ε) with the same `lith_code`, `lith_code_2` and `strat_unit` → INFO with a merge proposal. Thickness distribution per unit is reported with the issue.

LIT-003.logic: (a) **Forbidden sequences** from the profile and project rules (`FAM-901…`): e.g. a cover unit (`is_cover`) below bedrock, unless `allow_cover_below` (karst infill, thrust repetition) → WARNING. (b) **Stratigraphic inversion:** codes with `sequence_rank` whose rank decreases downhole, with no FAULT structure or `contact_top_type = FAULTED` within `fault_buffer_m` of the contact → WARNING. (c) **Rare transitions:** embedded Markov chain of downhole contacts (self-transitions removed), `P(i→j) = n_ij / n_i`. A transition with `n_ij ≤ rare_n` and `P ≤ rare_p`, whose expected count under quasi-independence is ≥ 5 → INFO "rare transition". The transition-probability matrix is a report figure.
LIT-003.reference: Brief §7; Vulcan Check Drillholes horizon sequence (RB)

LIT-004.title_en: First logged unit inconsistent with the geological map
LIT-004.title_fa: ناسازگاری نخستین واحد لاگ‌شده با نقشهٔ زمین‌شناسی
LIT-004.logic: ⟦`layer:GEOLOGICAL_MAP`, `drv_collar_spatial`⟧ The collar's `map_unit_code` is compared through `map_unit_lith_corr` with: the first logged unit; or, if that is cover (`is_cover`) and the map unit is not, the first bedrock unit (cover thickness reported). A map cover unit with logged bedrock at surface, or a `COVER_OVER` relation, → INFO "thin or unmapped cover". No match → WARNING. **Downgraded to INFO "near contact"** when `dist_map_contact_m` ≤ buffer = max(`buffer_min_m`, `map_scale_tol_mm`·`scale_denominator`/1000), e.g. 25 m at 1:25 000; also when the COL-010 method is HANDHELD or DIGITISED and the distance is within the buffer plus that method's position error. A map unit with no correlation entry → INFO asking for one (not a mismatch). Project outputs: confusion matrix (map unit × first logged unit), agreement %, Cohen's κ, map of matches.
LIT-004.fix: — ; FIELD: check the collar position, the map or the logging

LIT-005.logic: χ² test of logger × unit proportions (length-weighted counts), restricted to comparable ground: holes inside overlapping spatial windows (same drill section ± `window_m`, or convex-hull intersection) and overlapping elevation ranges, so that geology is not mistaken for a logger effect. Cramér's V ≥ `v_min` with p < `alpha` → INFO, listing the codes driving the difference (standardised residuals > 3). Also reports per-logger thin-interval share and diversity (LIT-006). MDE §1.9.
LIT-005.fix: FIELD: logging calibration session; targeted check-logging (INT-019)

LIT-006.title_fa: ناهنجاری تنوع لاگ (تفکیک بیش از حد یا ادغام)
LIT-006.logic: Per hole: Shannon diversity `H = −Σ p_k ln p_k` on length-weighted unit proportions, and units per 100 m. Robust z of H within campaign and area. |z| ≥ `z_robust` → INFO. A systematic per-logger or per-period difference is reported with LIT-005.

LIT-007.title_en: Cross-hole lithology inconsistency at similar elevation
LIT-007.title_fa: ناسازگاری سنگ‌شناسی گمانه‌های مجاور در ارتفاع مشابه
LIT-007.severity: INFO; ↑WARNING when one hole is the outlier in ≥ 3 pairs
LIT-007.logic: ⟦`drv_trace`, `drv_interval_master`⟧ For hole pairs within `max_pair_dist_m`, sample both traces at common elevations every `step_m` over their overlapping z-range and compare units at `group_code` level. The mismatch rate is computed against 3D distance class, and should increase with distance. A pair whose mismatch in the nearest distance class exceeds that class's median by ≥ `excess_min_frac` → INFO listing the pair (mislogging, swapped hole IDs, or a fault between them). MDE §1.9.
LIT-007.fix: — ; FIELD: re-log or check the hole identity

LIT-008.logic: Runs only when the profile defines an ordered `horizon_list` H1…Hn (top → bottom), each with `may_pinch_out` and `may_repeat`, plus `exempt_codes` (cover, intrusives, veins, faults, voids). After merging consecutive identical codes into picks with index k: **MISSING** (Hk absent while picks above and below k exist, and not `may_pinch_out`); **EXTRA** (code neither listed nor exempt); **REPEATED** (Hk in two non-adjacent picks with no fault record between them, unless `may_repeat`); **OUT_OF_SEQUENCE** (index decreases downhole without a fault flag). Optional neighbour test: horizon floor elevations from holes within `neighbour_radius_m` must not cross adjacent horizons by more than `crossing_tol_m`.

LIT-009.title_en: Surface observation inconsistent with the geological map
LIT-009.title_fa: ناسازگاری مشاهدات سطحی با نقشهٔ زمین‌شناسی
LIT-009.logic: ⟦`layer:SURFACE_SAMPLES` or `table:surface_obs` (Appendix C)⟧ Trench, outcrop and surface-sample units are compared with the map polygon through `map_unit_lith_corr`, with the LIT-004 buffer. Mismatch outside the buffer → WARNING. Summary agreement and κ → INFO.
LIT-009.reference: Brief §7.1 ("optional: trench and surface samples, outcrop points")

GEO-001.title_fa: بازیافت مغزه بیش از ۱۰۰ درصد یا منفی
GEO-001.logic: On `cr_pct_used`. CR < 0 → ERROR. CR > 100 + `cr_tol_pct` → ERROR. 100 < CR ≤ 100 + tolerance → INFO (measuring tolerance, swelling clays). **Diagnosis:** two consecutive runs, one above and one below 100 %, whose recovered lengths sum to within `cr_tol_pct` of the combined run length → "core-block misplacement", with a rebalancing proposal.

GEO-002.title_en: RQD greater than core recovery, or above 100 %
GEO-002.title_fa: RQD بزرگ‌تر از بازیافت مغزه یا بیش از ۱۰۰ درصد
GEO-002.logic: RQD and CR are both relative to run length (Deere; ISRM), so `rqd_length_m ≤ recovered_length_m` and RQD ≤ CR always. Flags: `rqd_pct_used` > `cr_pct_used` + `tol_pct`; RQD > 100 + `tol_pct`; RQD < 0 → ERROR.

GEO-003.title_en: Recorded and recomputed CR or RQD disagree
GEO-003.title_fa: مغایرت CR یا RQD ثبت‌شده با مقدار بازمحاسبه‌شده
GEO-003.logic: Where raw lengths exist: |`cr_pct_rec` − `cr_pct`| > `diff_tol_pct` → WARNING; the same for RQD. Also `run_length_m` ≠ `to_m − from_m` beyond `len_tol_m`. **Pattern diagnosis per logger or campaign:** RQD computed against recovered length instead of run length (RQD_rec ≈ 100·rqd_length/recovered); a 2 × core-diameter piece threshold instead of 0.10 m; CR recorded on sample intervals (`interval_basis`).

GEO-004.logic: Per drilling method and domain, each sample gets the length-weighted CR of overlapping runs (core) or `recovery_mass_pct` (RC). Recovery classes per `classes_pct`. Kruskal–Wallis across classes and Mann–Whitney between the lowest and highest classes on log grade; Spearman ρ(recovery, grade). A significant difference with effect ≥ MDE (§1.9) → WARNING. The message states the direction and both readings: grade **lower** at low recovery suggests loss of soft or sulphide-rich fines; grade **higher** at low recovery more often reflects fractured mineralised structures than a bias, so the correlation within mineralised intervals only is also reported.
GEO-004.reference: Brief §8; JORC T1.03 "whether a relationship exists between sample recovery and grade"
GEO-004.fix: — ; FIELD: improve recovery (triple tube, drilling muds)

GEO-005.title_en: Run length inconsistent with the core barrel
GEO-005.title_fa: ناسازگاری طول ران با طول لولهٔ مغزه‌گیر
GEO-005.logic: On `interval_basis = RUN` rows only. `run_length_m` > `barrel_length_m` + `tol_m` → WARNING (two runs merged, or a block error). Modal run length differing from the declared barrel by > `tol_m` → INFO (metadata check). Runs crossing a core-block depth from `table:drilling_progress` (Appendix C) by > `tol_m` → WARNING.
GEO-005.reference: Brief §8 ("run length distribution vs core barrel length")

GEO-006.title_en: Low core recovery within mineralised or reportable intercepts
GEO-006.title_fa: بازیافت پایین در بازه‌های کانه‌دار یا قابل گزارش
GEO-006.logic: Intercepts are defined with the VER-007 aggregation parameters, or from logged mineralisation. Run recovery is apportioned to each intercept by length overlap. Length-weighted recovery < `rec_warn_pct` → WARNING; < `rec_err_pct` → ERROR. A single sample inside an intercept below `sample_min_pct` → INFO. Project summary: % of intercept metres below `rec_warn_pct` by hole type, method and domain. RC uses `recovery_mass_pct`. GEO-004 tests the statistical relationship; this rule flags each intercept for disclosure and exclusion decisions.
GEO-006.reference: JORC T1.03 (RC; Code text not retrieved)
GEO-006.fix: — ; FIELD: qualify the intercept in public reporting

GEO-007.logic: RC holes and segments (`hole_segment`). `recovery_mass_pct` = field mass / theoretical mass, with the theoretical mass from the **bit** diameter (not the rod), interval length and density. Below `rc_rec_warn_pct` → WARNING (loss of fines); above `rc_rec_high_pct` → WARNING (over-collection or down-hole contamination; links ASY-026). Share of `WET` samples per hole, and inside mineralised intervals, above `wet_share_max_frac` → WARNING. Grade of wet vs dry samples: Mann–Whitney, as in ASY-026(c).
GEO-007.reference: Brief §8 ("for RC: recovered sample weights vs theoretical, wet/dry samples"); JORC T1.03
GEO-007.fix: FIELD: improve sample collection; review splitter moisture handling

GEO-008.severity: INFO; ↑WARNING when systematic for one logger
GEO-008.logic: Recomputes `ff_per_m = fracture_count / recovered_length_m` and compares it with any recorded FF. RQD expected from FF (λ, fractures per metre) under exponential spacing (Priest & Hudson 1976): `RQD_exp = 100·e^(−0.1λ)·(0.1λ + 1)`. |RQD − RQD_exp| > `pd_tol_pct` over ≥ `min_runs_n` runs of a logger or campaign → INFO. That usually means mechanical breaks were counted as natural fractures, or RQD was measured on a different basis. Single runs are not flagged, because fracture spacing is rarely exponential.

ALT-001.title_en: Invalid alteration code or intensity scale; mixed scales
ALT-001.title_fa: کد دگرسانی یا مقیاس شدت نامعتبر؛ مقیاس‌های مختلط
ALT-001.logic: (a) `alt_type`, `alt_mineral` or `style` without a CONFIRMED dictionary entry → WARNING, with synonym clusters as in LIT-001. (b) `intensity_raw` not parseable by any registered scale (`NUM_0_3`, `NUM_0_4`, `NUM_1_5`, `WMS`, `WMSI`, `PCT`) → WARNING. (c) A table, campaign or logger mixing scales (more than one `intensity_scale_id`) → WARNING, with the proposed mapping to the canonical 0–4 ordinal. (d) `intensity_ord` outside 0–4 → ERROR.

ALT-002.logic: ⟦`drv_assay_wide`⟧ Runs only on total or near-total digestion (four-acid, fusion, XRF), never aqua regia. Per interval: molar K/Al, Na/Al and (2Ca + Na + K)/Al (Pearce element ratios, Stanley & Madeisky 1994); Ishikawa AI = 100·(K₂O + MgO)/(K₂O + MgO + Na₂O + CaO); CCPI = 100·(MgO + FeOᵀ)/(MgO + FeOᵀ + Na₂O + K₂O). Expected fields per `alt_type` come from the profile, e.g. PHYLLIC: Na/Al < 0.1 and K/Al near the muscovite line (≈ 0.33); POTASSIC: K/Al toward 1 (K-feldspar) or a biotite signature; ARGILLIC / ADV_ARGILLIC: both K/Al and Na/Al < 0.1; PROPYLITIC: Na retained. (a) Logged intensity ≥ 3 with AI and CCPI inside the least-altered box → WARNING. (b) Logged none or weak with AI > `ai_strong_min` → WARNING. (c) Logged type outside its expected field for ≥ `min_share_frac` of a hole's intervals of that type → WARNING. (d) Logged quartz veining or silicification against SiO₂: Spearman ρ < 0 per hole with n ≥ 20 → INFO.
ALT-002.reference: Brief §9; Ishikawa et al. (1976); Large et al. (2001) alteration box plot; Stanley & Madeisky (1994)
ALT-002.fix: — ; FIELD: re-log a sample of intervals with the geochemistry beside the core

ALT-003.title_en: Alteration type without intensity, or intensity without type
ALT-003.title_fa: ثبت نوع دگرسانی بدون شدت یا شدت بدون نوع
ALT-003.logic: An `alteration_obs` row with `alt_type` and NULL `intensity_ord`, or the reverse → WARNING. ↓INFO for a campaign whose logging scheme declares no intensity.
ALT-003.reference: Brief §9 ("missing intensity where type is logged")

ALT-004.logic: (a) The same `alt_type` in two ranks of one interval → WARNING. (b) A rank gap (rank 2 without rank 1) → WARNING. (c) Secondary intensity above primary, where rank came from column order → INFO proposing a swap. (d) Profile `exclusive_pairs` (e.g. POTASSIC with ADV_ARGILLIC at intensity ≥ 3) without an overprint flag in `style` → INFO.

ALT-005.title_en: Alteration zoning order atypical for the deposit model
ALT-005.title_fa: ترتیب زون‌بندی دگرسانی نامتعارف برای مدل کانسار
ALT-005.logic: The profile's `zone_order` (porphyry: potassic core → phyllic → argillic or advanced argillic above → propylitic outer) is compared with the downhole sequence of dominant alteration, after merging zones thinner than `min_zone_m`. Inversions are counted per hole and mapped. **INFO only:** telescoping and overprinting are normal, so zoning is evidence for interpretation, not an error test.

MIN-001.title_en: Invalid mineral, style or vein code
MIN-001.title_fa: کد کانی، سبک کانی‌زایی یا رگهٔ نامعتبر
MIN-001.logic: `mineral`, `style` or `vein_type` without a CONFIRMED dictionary entry → WARNING, with synonym clusters (LIT-001 logic). A `vein_type` outside the profile's vein scheme (e.g. porphyry A, B, D, M, EB) → WARNING.

MIN-002.title_en: Mineral abundance out of range, or sum above 100 %
MIN-002.title_fa: فراوانی کانی خارج از محدوده یا مجموع بیش از ۱۰۰ درصد
MIN-002.logic: `pct` or `vein_pct` outside 0–100 → ERROR. Σ `pct` of MINERAL observations in an interval > `sum_max_pct` → WARNING. `veins_per_m` > `veins_per_m_max` → WARNING. A table where > 50 % of `pct_qual` values are `TRACE`, `RANGE`, `LT` or `GT` → INFO "semi-quantitative logging" (limits MIN-003).

MIN-003.title_en: Logged sulphide abundance inconsistent with the sulphur assay
MIN-003.title_fa: ناسازگاری درصد سولفید لاگ‌شده با عیار گوگرد
MIN-003.logic: Expected S from logged minerals, converting volume % to weight %: `S_exp = Σ pct_k·(ρ_k/ρ_rock)·s_k`. Shipped S mass fractions s and densities ρ (g/cm³): pyrite 0.535 / 5.0; chalcopyrite 0.349 / 4.2; pyrrhotite ≈ 0.39 / 4.6; sphalerite 0.329 / 4.0; galena 0.134 / 7.5; bornite 0.256 / 5.1; chalcocite 0.201 / 5.7; arsenopyrite 0.197 / 6.1; molybdenite 0.401 / 4.7. Compared with total S (LECO or four-acid) where S_obs ≥ 10 × DL or S_exp ≥ 0.5 %: |log₁₀(S_exp/S_obs)| > `log_tol` → WARNING. A systematic ratio per logger → INFO "visual-estimate calibration". Intervals logged OXIDE or LEACHED are excluded, because S there is partly sulphate or leached.

MIN-004.title_en: Mineral assemblage inconsistent with the oxidation state
MIN-004.title_fa: ناسازگاری مجموعهٔ کانیایی با وضعیت اکسیداسیون
MIN-004.logic: Using the mineral `group_code` and the `weathering` table: oxide-copper minerals (malachite, azurite, cuprite, chrysocolla) or jarosite in PRIMARY → WARNING; primary sulphides ≥ `sulph_pct` in LEACHED → WARNING; chalcocite or covellite in PRIMARY more than `tol_m` below the hole's base of oxidation → INFO, because hypogene chalcocite and covellite occur in high-sulphidation systems.

MIN-005.logic: `vein_pct` > 0 with `veins_per_m` = 0, or the reverse → INFO. `vein_pct` > `vein_pct_high` with `veins_per_m` < 1 and no vein width → WARNING. Quartz-vein % against SiO₂ is ALT-002(d).

MIN-006.title_en: Total sulphide inconsistent with the sum of logged sulphide minerals
MIN-006.title_fa: ناسازگاری درصد کل سولفید با مجموع کانی‌های سولفیدی ثبت‌شده
MIN-006.logic: Where both exist, a `TOTAL_SULPHIDE` observation vs Σ `pct` of minerals whose `group_code = SULPHIDE`: |difference| > max(`abs_tol_pct`, `rel_tol_frac` × total) → WARNING.

MIN-007.title_en: Required mineral abundance or vein type missing
MIN-007.title_fa: نبود فراوانی کانی یا نوع رگهٔ الزامی
MIN-007.logic: A MINERAL observation without `pct` where the profile requires semi-quantitative logging; a VEIN observation without `vein_type` → WARNING. ↓INFO for campaigns declared as legacy.

WTH-001.title_en: Illogical oxidation or weathering sequence downhole
WTH-001.title_fa: توالی غیرمنطقی اکسیداسیون یا هوازدگی در طول گمانه
WTH-001.logic: Expected downhole order by `sequence_rank`: oxidation LEACHED → OXIDE → MIXED → SUPERGENE → PRIMARY; weathering grade decreasing from W6 to W1. An inversion is a higher rank above a lower one, with the out-of-order zone ≥ `min_inversion_m` thick. One WARNING per hole lists all inversions. ↓INFO "fault-controlled" when a FAULT or SHEAR structure, or a FAULTED contact, lies within `fault_buffer_m` of the inverted zone, since deep oxidation along faults is real.

WTH-002.logic: `weathering_grade`, `oxidation_state` or `limonite_type` without a CONFIRMED dictionary entry → WARNING. A row with both `weathering_grade` and `oxidation_state` NULL (conditional requirement, 02 §4.14) → WARNING.

WTH-003.logic: Copper systems with sequential or partial Cu analyses: `r = CuAS/CuT` (or CuOx/CuT). Expected r ≥ `ox_ratio_min_frac` in OXIDE, ≤ `prim_ratio_max_frac` in PRIMARY, intermediate in MIXED; a contradiction → WARNING. Sulphur proxy for any system: OXIDE or LEACHED with S ≥ `s_prim_min_pct` in mineralised rock, or PRIMARY with S ≤ `s_ox_max_pct` where Cu or Au is mineralised → WARNING. The CuAS ≤ CuT inequality itself is ASY-006(c).
WTH-003.reference: Brief §9 ("logged oxidation vs CuO / acid-soluble Cu or S depletion")

WTH-004.title_en: Base of oxidation inconsistent between neighbouring holes
WTH-004.title_fa: ناهمخوانی قاعدهٔ زون اکسیدان بین گمانه‌های مجاور
WTH-004.logic: ⟦`drv_pierce_point` (BOCO, TOFR)⟧ Per hole, base of complete oxidation (BOCO) and top of fresh rock (TOFR), as elevation and as depth below the DEM. Compared with the median of neighbours within `radius_m`. |residual| > max(`abs_tol_m`, `k_mad`·1.4826·MAD) → WARNING: mislogging, or genuinely deep fault-controlled weathering. Produces the BOCO / TOFR maps.
WTH-004.reference: Brief §9 ("map of base of oxidation; inconsistencies between neighbouring holes")

WTH-005.title_en: Weathering grade contradicts the oxidation state
WTH-005.title_fa: تناقض درجهٔ هوازدگی با وضعیت اکسیداسیون
WTH-005.logic: Profile-defined contradictory pairs, by default W1 (fresh) with OXIDE or LEACHED, and W5–W6 with PRIMARY → WARNING. Can be disabled where the two decouple (e.g. silicified leached caps).

DEN-001.severity: WARNING; ↑ERROR outside the absolute bounds (physically implausible)
DEN-001.logic: `density_gcm3` outside `abs_bounds_gcm3` → ↑ERROR (no rock has that density; a unit or keying error). Within the absolute bounds: outside the profile's `density_bounds_gcm3[group]` for the lithology group, or outside the robust fence median ± `k_mad`·1.4826·MAD of that lithology (n ≥ 20) → WARNING. The issue reports both bounds and the lithology statistics. Descriptive rule (§1.9).
DEN-001.parameters: `abs_bounds_gcm3` [1.0, 6.5]; `density_bounds_gcm3` per group (profile, e.g. granitoid 2.5–2.8, basalt 2.7–3.1, massive sulphide 3.5–4.8, magnetite ore 4.0–5.2, coal 1.2–1.8); `k_mad` 4

DEN-002.title_en: Density method or basis inappropriate for the material
DEN-002.title_fa: روش یا مبنای اندازه‌گیری چگالی نامناسب با جنس نمونه
DEN-002.logic: (a) Uncoated water immersion on material logged oxide, highly weathered, vuggy, porous or clay-rich (`porous_codes`) → WARNING, because water ingress drives the result toward grain density. (b) `GRAIN_SG` (pycnometer) used as bulk density → ERROR. (c) `density_kind = UNKNOWN` → INFO. (d) `WET_BULK` without `moisture_pct` when tonnage is reported dry → WARNING.
DEN-002.reference: JORC Table 1 Section 3 "Bulk density"; CIM Estimation BPG 2019 §4.3 (RC; JORC wording not retrieved)

DEN-003.title_en: Assigned or constant density recorded as measured
DEN-003.title_fa: مقادیر چگالی ثابت یا فرضی ثبت‌شده به‌جای اندازه‌گیری
DEN-003.logic: Per lithology or domain: > `share_thr_frac` of records sharing one value (especially round values 2.50, 2.60, 2.65, 2.70, 2.80); ≥ `run_thr_n` consecutive identical downhole values; density on every interval with variance < `variance_floor`; or values with `method` NULL. → WARNING with a proposal to relabel them as assumed (`is_assumed`, Appendix C) and exclude them from density statistics and regressions.
DEN-003.reference: JORC Table 1 Section 3 "Bulk density" ("whether assumed or determined") (RC)

DEN-004.title_en: Recorded density disagrees with masses, or masses physically impossible
DEN-004.title_fa: مغایرت چگالی ثبت‌شده با جرم‌ها یا جرم‌های ناممکن
DEN-004.logic: Where masses exist (02 §4.16): |recorded − `density_calc_gcm3`| / calc > `rel_tol_frac` → WARNING. Physically impossible masses → ERROR: `mass_water_g ≥ mass_air_g` (uncoated); coated mass in air < uncoated mass; coated mass in water ≥ coated mass in air. A coating volume above `coat_vol_max_frac` of the sample volume → WARNING (the wax correction dominates the result). Water density uses `water_temp_c`, or 20 °C with an INFO note.

DEN-005.title_en: Density coverage insufficient for mineralised domains or weathering classes
DEN-005.title_fa: پوشش ناکافی اندازه‌گیری چگالی در دامنه‌های کانه‌دار یا رده‌های هوازدگی
DEN-005.logic: Per domain (lithology group × weathering class × mineralised flag): n < `min_n_per_domain` → WARNING; measured share / metres share < `coverage_ratio_min` → WARNING (class under-sampled); no measurement in a mineralised domain → ERROR.
DEN-005.reference: Brief §10 ("coverage relative to mineralised zones"); JORC S3; CIM 2019 §4.3 (RC)

DEN-006.title_en: Density equipment calibration missing or expired
DEN-006.title_fa: نبود یا انقضای کالیبراسیون تجهیزات اندازه‌گیری چگالی
DEN-006.logic: ⟦`table:instrument_register`⟧ (Appendix C). The SUR-029 calibration family applied to balances: certificate expired at `measure_date`, or no serial. Where a reference block is measured per batch (e.g. aluminium or quartz), |measured − known| > `ref_tol_gcm3` → WARNING. Without a register, one INFO disclosure is raised.
DEN-006.reference: JORC T1.01 "appropriate calibration of any measurement tools" (RC)

DEN-007.title_en: Density inconsistent with a grade-based expectation
DEN-007.title_fa: ناسازگاری چگالی با مقدار مورد انتظار بر پایهٔ عیار
DEN-007.logic: Where the profile defines a density–grade relation (iron ores: ρ on Fe; massive sulphides: ρ on S or Cu + Pb + Zn; chromite: ρ on Cr₂O₃; barite: ρ on Ba), a robust regression (Theil–Sen) is fitted per domain on measured pairs. |residual| > `k_mad`·1.4826·MAD → WARNING. The fitted regression is reported as a *suggestion* for assigning density to unmeasured intervals.

MAG-001.title_en: Magnetic susceptibility units mixed or inferred
MAG-001.title_fa: واحد پذیرفتاری مغناطیسی مختلط یا استنتاجی
MAG-001.logic: Two-component GMM on log₁₀ MS per instrument and campaign. Components separated by `sep_decades` ± 0.3 (a factor of 100: ×10⁻³ vs ×10⁻⁵ SI), with the minority ≥ `minority_frac` → ERROR "mixed units", never bulk-converted. A unit inferred only from magnitude or instrument → WARNING until confirmed (IMP-016). MDE §1.9.
MAG-001.fix: Confirm the inference; per-campaign unit change set

MAG-002.logic: `ms_e3_si` < `neg_min_e3_si` → WARNING (diamagnetic rock is only slightly negative, about −0.01). Above `max_e3_si` → WARNING (above massive magnetite). The same maximum value repeated, i.e. instrument saturation → WARNING.

MAG-003.title_en: Magnetic susceptibility inconsistent with logged magnetite or Fe
MAG-003.title_fa: ناسازگاری پذیرفتاری مغناطیسی با مگنتیت لاگ‌شده یا آهن
MAG-003.logic: Expected MS from logged magnetite volume %: `k_exp ≈ k_per_vol_pct × V_mt` (about 35 × 10⁻³ SI per 1 vol % magnetite at low concentrations). (a) Logged magnetite ≥ `mt_pct_min` with |log₁₀(k_obs/k_exp)| > `log_tol` → WARNING. (b) MS ≥ `high_ms_e3_si` with neither magnetite nor pyrrhotite logged → WARNING. (c) In Fe profiles, Spearman ρ(MS, Fe) per domain < 0.3 → INFO. Martite and hematite carry low MS, so `limonite_type`/`HEM` logging suppresses (a) where magnetite is not separately logged.
MAG-003.reference: Brief §9–§10 ("logged magnetite vs Fe / magnetic susceptibility")

MAG-004.title_en: MS instrument calibration or core-size correction missing
MAG-004.title_fa: نبود کالیبراسیون دستگاه یا تصحیح قطر مغزه
MAG-004.logic: ⟦`table:instrument_register`⟧ (Appendix C). The SUR-029 calibration family: no certificate or check at `measure_date` → WARNING. `core_diameter_corrected` NULL or FALSE in a project mixing core sizes (e.g. NQ and HQ) → WARNING, because hand-held meters such as the KT-10 apply diameter-dependent corrections. Without a register, one INFO disclosure.

STR-001.logic: α outside 0–90; β or γ outside [0, 360); recorded dip outside 0–90 or dip direction outside [0, 360); `width_m` < 0 → ERROR. β or γ = 360 → INFO (normalised to 0). α exactly 0 or 90 on > `round_share_frac` of rows → INFO (resolution, or defaults entered).

STR-002.title_en: Oriented-core flags, reference line or quality inconsistent
STR-002.title_fa: ناسازگاری نشانه‌های مغزهٔ جهت‌دار، خط مرجع یا کیفیت جهت‌یابی
STR-002.logic: β without `ref_line` → WARNING (BOH assumed and stated). β with `orientation_quality` 0 or 3 → WARNING (β unusable; no dip or dip direction is computed). α/β in RC holes or segments, or with `orientation_tool = NONE` → ERROR. Recorded dip direction without `dip_dir_ref` → WARNING.

STR-003.logic: `struct_type` or `orientation_quality` without a CONFIRMED dictionary entry → WARNING, with synonym clusters (LIT-001 logic).

STR-004.title_en: Oriented-core measurement without adequate survey control
STR-004.title_fa: اندازه‌گیری مغزهٔ جهت‌دار بدون کنترل کافی انحراف‌سنجی
STR-004.logic: For each α/β row: the hole has no survey (COL-008, COL-019) or is design-only (SUR-009) → WARNING. `depth_m` more than `max_extrap_m` beyond the last or before the first station → WARNING. The bracketing station interval is longer than `max_bracket_m`, contains a dogleg ≥ the SUR-010 WARNING band, or has azimuths flagged by SUR-013 → WARNING. The issue reports the angular uncertainty of the hole axis at that depth, which rotates every plane by up to the same angle.
STR-004.reference: Leapfrog Geo α/β conversion using the hole trace (RB)

STR-005.title_en: Recorded orientation disagrees with the value recomputed from α/β
STR-005.title_fa: مغایرت جهت ثبت‌شده با مقدار بازمحاسبه از آلفا و بتا
STR-005.logic: Where both α/β and recorded dip/dip direction exist: θ = angle between the recomputed and recorded poles. θ > `warn_deg` → WARNING; θ > `error_deg` → ERROR. **Convention diagnosis** per logger and campaign. Four hypotheses are tested: (a) β + 180° (top-of-core reference); (b) dip sign or hole dip convention flipped; (c) α/β mapped as dip/dip direction; (d) survey azimuth MAG vs GRID. A hypothesis that brings ≥ `systematic_share` of rows below `warn_deg` is reported as the probable convention error.
STR-005.reference: Leapfrog Geo β reference setting; Seequent community case of α/β imported as dip/azimuth (RB)

STR-006.logic: Per structure type or stereonet cluster: the share of measurements with α < `blind_alpha_deg`. Terzaghi weights `w = 1/sin α`, capped at `w_max`. Weighted and unweighted set proportions differing by > `diff_frac` → INFO "set under-represented: drilling sub-parallel to it", linked to SPA-005.

SMP-001.title_fa: شناسهٔ نمونه در کل پروژه یکتا نیست
SMP-001.logic: The same `sample_id` on more than one register row → ERROR. IDs that coincide only after the shared normalisation key (case, leading zeros, separators; COL-003 key) → WARNING "near-duplicate".
SMP-001.reference: Brief §10 ("sample number uniqueness"); Discover duplicate sample numbers (RB)

SMP-002.title_en: Sample-number sequence gaps or unused tickets
SMP-002.title_fa: شکاف در توالی شمارهٔ نمونه یا بلیت‌های استفاده‌نشده
SMP-002.logic: The numeric part of each prefix series is parsed per dispatch and per hole. Gaps not explained by `sample_status` VOID, LOST or NOT_SENT, or by QC slots → INFO. ↑WARNING when the gap lies inside a mineralised interval, or exceeds `gap_share_max_frac` of a dispatch.

SMP-003.title_en: Sample ID with conflicting hole, depth or type across tables
SMP-003.title_fa: شناسهٔ نمونه با گمانه، عمق یا نوع متناقض در جداول مختلف
SMP-003.logic: Global index of `sample_id` over the register, dispatch lists, assay rows carrying depths, interval tables carrying sample IDs (e.g. density) and the QC register. Same ID with a different `hole_id` → ERROR. |Δfrom| or |Δto| > `depth_tol_m` → ERROR. Used both as a drill sample and as a QC insert → ERROR. `sample_type` differing between tables → WARNING. Adjacent numbers swapped between holes, or out of downhole order within a dispatch → INFO "possible transposition".
SMP-003.reference: Vulcan Isis global validation; Discover duplicate sample numbers; acQuire and MX Deposit sample-centric models (RA, RB, RC)
SMP-003.status: NEW: Vulcan, Discover, acQuire, MX Deposit (RA, RB, RC)

SMP-004.title_en: Orphan result: sample not in the register or any dispatch
SMP-004.title_fa: نتیجهٔ یتیم: نمونه در ثبت نمونه یا محموله‌ها وجود ندارد
SMP-004.logic: Each result's `sample_id` is tested against the union of the sample and QC registers. Not found → ERROR. Candidate matches are proposed: leading-zero and prefix normalisation, Levenshtein ≤ `fuzzy_max_distance`, adjacent-digit transposition, lab suffixes (`-R`, `DUP`, `RPT`); only candidates whose dispatch and lab job agree are shown. Found, but in a different dispatch or lab than the certificate states → WARNING "mis-routed". Orphan results do not enter `drv_assay_wide` until resolved.
SMP-004.reference: Datamine SABLE Lab QM; Studio Mapper → Fusion export ID clashes; acQuire results and despatch tables (RA)

SMP-005.title_en: Dispatched sample with no returned result (outstanding or unreported)
SMP-005.title_fa: نمونهٔ ارسال‌شده بدون نتیجه (معوق یا گزارش‌نشده)
SMP-005.logic: For each dispatched sample: **OUTSTANDING** (no result yet) → INFO while age ≤ `turnaround_days`, WARNING after. **UNREPORTED** (the lab job is FINAL but the sample is absent) → WARNING. Laboratory condition codes (not received, insufficient, lost) are counted separately from ASY-002. Output: reconciliation table per dispatch (sent, received at the lab, reported, outstanding, condition-coded). ASY-008 reads this status to tell "pending at the lab" from "never sampled".
SMP-005.reference: Micromine Geobank Sample Tracker; MX Deposit dispatch → certificate workflow; SABLE TrackSamp; acQuire despatch (RA)
SMP-005.status: NEW: Geobank, MX Deposit, SABLE, acQuire (RA)

SMP-006.title_en: Requested analytical suite differs from the returned methods or analytes
SMP-006.title_fa: مغایرت بستهٔ آنالیز درخواستی با روش‌ها یا عناصر گزارش‌شده
SMP-006.logic: ⟦`dispatch.requested_suite`⟧ (Appendix C). Requested preparation and analysis codes vs those on the certificate. Requested analytes missing (partial certificate, or an import mapping that dropped a column); unrequested methods (wrong scheme, another client's job); a different digestion or finish → WARNING. Within one certificate, samples missing analytes that ≥ `majority_frac` of the batch reports → WARNING.
SMP-006.reference: MX Deposit dispatch services schedule and Method Details; Geobank 2017 lab-file mapping (RA)

SMP-007.title_en: Sample mass inconsistent (theoretical, field, dispatched, received)
SMP-007.title_fa: ناسازگاری جرم نمونه (نظری، صحرایی، ارسالی، دریافتی)
SMP-007.logic: (a) **Core:** `R = weight_received_kg / weight_theoretical_kg`, where the theoretical mass = split fraction (1, ½, ¼ from `sample_method`) × π(D/2)² × length × ρ × recovery. D comes from the core-size table. R < `ratio_low` or > `ratio_high` → WARNING (wrong split, wrong interval, mislabelled bag, unlogged core loss). (b) **Custody:** `r = (w_lab − w_dispatch)/w_dispatch`, |r| > `dispatch_tol_dry` (or `_wet` for WET samples) → WARNING. Dispatched and lab-registered counts differing → ERROR. (c) **Trend:** a batch median r below −`systematic_loss` → INFO (loss of fines or spillage). RC recovery against theoretical mass is GEO-007.
SMP-007.parameters: `core_diam_mm` {BQ 36.5, NQ 47.6, NQ2 50.6, NQ3 45.0, HQ 63.5, HQ3 61.1, PQ 85.0, PQ3 83.0}; `ratio_low` 0.6; `ratio_high` 1.4; `dispatch_tol_dry` 0.05; `dispatch_tol_wet` 0.10; `systematic_loss` 0.10
SMP-007.reference: Brief §10 ("sample-weight checks"); ALS WEI-21 received weight; Geobank dispatch/receipt reconciliation; consultant audit practice (RA, RC)
SMP-007.status: BRIEF-PROSE §10 + NEW: ALS, Geobank, audit practice (RA, RC)

SMP-008.title_en: Sample-chain chronology violation or turnaround anomaly
SMP-008.title_fa: نقض ترتیب زمانی زنجیرهٔ نمونه یا ناهنجاری زمان پاسخ‌دهی
SMP-008.logic: Dates (after IMP-014 calendar normalisation) must run in order: drilling (collar start, or interval date) ≤ logged ≤ sampled ≤ dispatched ≤ received at lab ≤ certificate ≤ import. Each reversal beyond `tolerance_days` → WARNING. A future date → WARNING. A sample dispatched before its hole was started (wrong hole assignment), or a certificate dated before its dispatch (wrong job link) → WARNING. Turnaround (dispatch → certificate) above the lab's P95 or `max_turnaround_days` → INFO.
SMP-008.reference: MX Deposit formula validations ("finish date cannot be earlier than start") (RA)

SMP-009.title_en: Chain-of-custody record incomplete or seals mismatched
SMP-009.title_fa: سابقهٔ زنجیرهٔ نگهداری ناقص یا مغایرت پلمب‌ها
SMP-009.logic: (a) A resource-drilling sample without `dispatch_id`, or a dispatch without a lab receipt (`date_received_lab`, `received_by`) → WARNING. (b) Seal numbers missing (when `require_seals`), not matching between dispatch and receipt, or reported broken → WARNING; `condition_on_receipt = TAMPERED` → ERROR. (c) Receipt at a lab or location other than the one dispatched to → WARNING. (d) `custody_event` gaps or out-of-order events for a dispatch → WARNING.
SMP-009.reference: Brief §10 ("dispatch/batch linkage, chain-of-custody fields"); SABLE TrackSamp; MX Deposit dispatch headers (RA)

SMP-010.title_en: Preliminary or superseded certificate in use, or certificate imported twice
SMP-010.title_fa: استفاده از گواهی مقدماتی یا جایگزین‌شده، یا ورود دوبارهٔ گواهی
SMP-010.logic: ⟦`lab_batch.certificate_status`, `certificate_version`, `file_id`⟧ A value derived from a PRELIMINARY certificate when a FINAL one exists, or from a superseded revision when an amended one exists → ERROR. The same file hash, or the same (lab job, revision), imported twice → ERROR. The same (sample, analyte, method) in two certificates with different values and no re-assay link → WARNING, handed to ASY-009.
SMP-010.reference: acQuire import object and data-load order; MX Deposit certificate import; Fusion and Studio Mapper no-overwrite behaviour (RA)

SMP-011.logic: ⟦`table:photo_index`⟧ (Appendix C), built from a directory listing or table, parsing `hole_id`, box, from, to and wet/dry from file names (editable regex). Per hole: photographed length / cored length < `coverage_min_frac` → WARNING. A mineralised intercept, or an interval carrying an open CRITICAL or ERROR issue, without a photo → WARNING. Photos without a depth range, or beyond EOH → INFO. The review panel opens the photo beside the issue.
SMP-011.reference: JORC T1.04 ("core or costean photography"); consultant verification practice (RC)

CRS-001.title_en: High grade in a logged barren unit, or low grade in a logged ore zone
CRS-001.title_fa: عیار بالا در واحد بی‌کانهٔ لاگ‌شده یا عیار پایین در زون کانه‌دار لاگ‌شده
CRS-001.logic: Per sample in `drv_interval_master`: a code with `mineralisation_class = BARREN` (post-mineral dyke, cover, barren host) and grade > `hi_factor` × cut-off, or above the mineralised-domain P95 → INFO. A MINERALISED interval ≥ `min_len_m` whose length-weighted grade < `lo_factor` × cut-off → INFO. ≥ `cluster_n` consecutive such samples in one hole → WARNING (systematic mislogging, or a hole or sample mismatch).
CRS-001.fix: — ; FIELD: re-log, or check the sample sequence (QAQ-014)

CRS-002.title_fa: اریبی عیار وابسته به روش حفاری
CRS-002.logic: Spatially comparable composites of different `drill_method` (RC vs DD, and others) in the same domain, paired within d ≤ min(`pair_dist_m`, `frac_spacing` × drill spacing). Paired relative difference, Q-Q plot, Wilcoxon on log, two-sample KS on the domain distributions, declustered means by method with bootstrap CIs. |median relative difference| ≥ `thr_warn_frac` with p < 0.01 and ≥ `min_pairs` → WARNING. Fewer pairs → INFO recommending twin holes (CRS-006). MDE §1.9.

CRS-003.title_en: Mineralised zone without support in neighbouring holes
CRS-003.title_fa: زون کانه‌دار بدون پشتیبانی در گمانه‌های مجاور
CRS-003.logic: Mineralised intercepts (profile cut-off) and their mid-point elevations via `drv_pierce_point`. An intercept whose neighbours within `radius_m` have no mineralised intercept within ± `dz_m` → INFO "isolated intercept": possibly genuine short-range structure, possibly misplaced data (wrong collar, survey or sample assignment). With a horizon list (LIT-008), the vertical offset between neighbouring intercepts > `dz_m` → INFO.

CRS-004.title_en: Candidate estimation domains not statistically separated
CRS-004.title_fa: عدم تفکیک آماری دامنه‌های پیشنهادی تخمین
CRS-004.logic: On composites of each key analyte: Kruskal–Wallis across the lithology × alteration (and weathering) classes, then Holm-adjusted pairwise tests. Adjacent classes (ordered by median) with no significant difference **or** an effect < `effect_min` pooled MAD (v0.2: with thousands of samples even trivial differences are significant, so practical equivalence also counts) → INFO "merge candidates". Classes that differ significantly but sit in one profile domain → INFO "split candidate". CV > 2 within a domain → INFO "mixed populations". Produces the domain-suggestion table (report §11). MDE §1.9.

CRS-005.logic: Grade against signed distance along the hole to each contact between candidate domains, binned at composite length up to ± `max_dist_m`. A step model and a linear-ramp (gradational) model are fitted and compared by AIC. A transition width ≥ 2 composite lengths → INFO "soft boundary: share samples across the contact in estimation"; otherwise "hard boundary". Informs domaining; not an error test.
CRS-005.reference: Brief §11 ("contact analysis: hard vs soft boundaries")

CRS-006.title_fa: مغایرت عیار یا ضخامت در گمانه‌های دوقلو
CRS-006.logic: Twin pairs from COL-004 (≤ `twin_max_distance_m` at the mineralised pierce point). Composites are matched by relative position along the mineralised intercept. Paired relative difference, Q-Q, mean difference, and intercept thickness and position. |median relative difference| ≥ `thr_warn_frac` with p < 0.01 → WARNING. Intercept thickness differing by > `thick_tol_frac` → WARNING. Reported by method pair (e.g. RC vs DD). Fewer than `min_pairs` matched composites → INFO.

CRS-007.title_en: Grade bias between laboratories, methods or campaigns in spatially paired data
CRS-007.title_fa: اریبی عیار بین آزمایشگاه‌ها، روش‌ها یا فازها در داده‌های جفت‌شدهٔ مکانی
CRS-007.logic: CRS-002 generalised to grouping G ∈ {lab, analytical method, campaign or era, sample type}. Within each domain, equal-length composites from different G paired within d ≤ min(`pair_dist_m`, `frac_spacing` × spacing). |median relative difference| > `thr_warn_frac` with p < 0.01 and ≥ `min_pairs` → WARNING; > `thr_err_frac` for legacy vs modern data → ERROR (legacy data may need exclusion or adjustment). Insufficient pairs → INFO recommending twins or re-assay of legacy pulps.
CRS-007.reference: NI 43-101 Item 12 and CSA Staff Notice 43-311 on legacy data; Abzalov (2009) (RC)

CRS-008.title_en: QC sample carried as a downhole interval
CRS-008.title_fa: نمونهٔ کنترلی ثبت‌شده به‌عنوان بازهٔ درون‌چاهی
CRS-008.logic: Any row whose type (from the register, or inferred by QAQ-006 or QAQ-013) is CRM, BLANK, PULP_DUP, LAB_* or UMPIRE and which carries `hole_id`, `from_m`, `to_m` in an assay interval table used for export → CRITICAL. Field or coarse duplicates occupying the same interval as their parent in the interval table (a double sample) → CRITICAL. Routine samples with no depths → ERROR. Export pipelines exclude flagged rows.
CRS-008.reference: acQuire Sample/CheckSample separation; MX Deposit sample types; Studio Mapper → Fusion export (RA)
CRS-008.fix: VOID the interval row (the QC record is kept)
CRS-008.status: NEW: acQuire, MX Deposit, Studio Mapper (RA)

CRS-009.title_fa: مسائل پشتیبانی کامپوزیت؛ پیشنهاد طول کامپوزیت
CRS-009.logic: ⟦`drv_composite`⟧ Recommended composite length = the modal sample length in mineralised domains, or a multiple of it ≥ the mode (INFO, with the sample-length histogram). Residual composites below `min_cov_frac` of the target length → INFO with counts by hole and the handling choice. A share of samples longer than the composite length > `long_share_frac` → WARNING (splitting long samples creates false resolution). Composites crossing domain boundaries when domain compositing was requested → WARNING.

CRS-010.title_en: Parent data duplicated in a wedge or daughter hole
CRS-010.title_fa: تکرار داده‌های گمانهٔ مادر در گمانهٔ فرعی (وج)
CRS-010.logic: For each parent–daughter pair (COL-004, COL-021, SUR-025): every daughter interval with `from_m` < `kickoff_depth_m` − `tol_m` in sampled tables (assay, density, geotech, magsus). It matches a parent interval (|Δfrom|, |Δto| ≤ `tol_m`, values within `value_rel_tol`) → ERROR "duplicated parent data". Depths match but values differ → WARNING "conflicting data in wedge hole". In logging tables the duplicates are often deliberate → INFO.
CRS-010.reference: Leapfrog Geo wedge-hole warnings ("conflicting data", "overlapping segments in wedge hole") (RB)
CRS-010.fix: SET `exclude_from_estimation` on daughter rows above the kick-off (Appendix C); never delete

SPA-001.logic: For each composite: k nearest neighbours in 3D **from other holes** (so the down-hole sequence does not dominate; down-hole discontinuities are ASY-025), with anisotropy scaling from the profile if given. Row-standardised local Moran `Iᵢ = zᵢ·Σⱼ wᵢⱼ zⱼ` on standardised log grade. Significance by `n_perm` conditional permutations, with Benjamini–Hochberg FDR at `q`. HL (high among low) and LH outliers → INFO; HH and LL clusters are mapped, not flagged. ↑WARNING when the outlier coincides with a QAQ-014 or ASY-025 swap candidate. MDE §1.9.
SPA-001.fix: — ; FIELD: check the sample, certificate and location

SPA-002.logic: Gi* z-scores with the SPA-001 neighbourhood, permutation inference and FDR. A significant hot spot supported by ≤ `isolated_n` samples → INFO "single-sample hot spot: verify". Larger hot spots are mapped as context for domaining and declustering (COL-015).

SPA-003.title_en: Samples inside mined voids or old workings
SPA-003.title_fa: نمونه‌های واقع در فضاهای استخراج‌شده یا کارهای قدیمی
SPA-003.logic: ⟦`layer:VOID`⟧ (Appendix C: void solids or centrelines for stopes, drives, shafts, historic workings, karst). For each desurveyed interval, the fraction f of its length inside a solid or within `buffer_m` of a centreline. f > `inside_share` and the interval has an assay, recovery > 0 or a non-void lithology → WARNING; ≥ `consecutive_for_error` consecutive such intervals → ERROR (collar, survey or void-model error). Intervals logged VOID / CAVITY / NO_CORE with no void within `unmapped_void_search_m` → INFO "unmapped working". Holes drilled before the void was created are skipped when dates exist.
SPA-003.reference: Maptek Vulcan Underground "Drill Hole Warning" (proximity to centrelines or triangulations), adapted to validation (RB)
SPA-003.fix: — ; FIELD: check the void model and the hole survey

SPA-004.title_en: Drill trace or samples outside the licence boundary at depth
SPA-004.title_fa: مسیر گمانه یا نمونه‌ها خارج از محدودهٔ پروانه در عمق
SPA-004.logic: ⟦`layer:LICENCE`, `drv_trace`⟧ Holes collared inside the licence (or within the COL-005 edge buffer) with ≥ 1 sampled interval mid-point outside the polygon by more than `buffer_m` → WARNING, listing metres, samples and metal × length outside per key analyte. Collar outside and samples inside → INFO. With a licence elevation limit, z is tested too. A licence polygon that does not close or self-intersects → ERROR (02 §4.21).
SPA-004.reference: Domain knowledge: GIS-integrated drillhole practice (Discover, Target) (RB; no vendor rule verified)

SPA-005.title_en: Low intersection angle between drill trace and mineralised structure
SPA-005.title_fa: زاویهٔ برخورد کم بین مسیر گمانه و ساختار کانه‌دار
SPA-005.logic: Orientation source, in priority order: (1) oriented-core α of structures flagged mineralised inside the intercept (θ = α); (2) a domain plane (dip / dip direction) or wireframe normal, θ = 90° − angle(trace vector at the pierce point, plane normal). True-thickness factor ≈ sin θ. θ < `theta_warn_deg` → WARNING (apparent width > 2 × true width); θ < `theta_err_deg` → ERROR (drilling sub-parallel to mineralisation; sampling bias likely). Project summary: θ distribution by domain and the % of intercepts below `theta_warn_deg` (report §3.4 orientation statement).
SPA-005.reference: JORC T1.10 "orientation of data in relation to geological structure" (RC; Code text not retrieved)

VER-001.title_en: Holes added or removed between versions
VER-001.title_fa: گمانه‌های افزوده یا حذف‌شده بین نسخه‌ها
VER-001.logic: Diff by `hole_id` through the alias map. Added holes → INFO (one summary). A removed hole → WARNING; it is listed with its metres and assays, and VER-006 tests whether the removal was documented.

VER-002.title_fa: تغییر مختصات یا عمق نهایی دهانهٔ گمانه
VER-002.logic: Per hole: Δx, Δy, Δz and ΔEOH. Above `tol_xy_m`, `tol_z_m` or `tol_eoh_m` → INFO each. A **common shift** shared by ≥ `shift_min_frac` of the changed holes (median Δ vector with small MAD), or a rotation or scale fitted by Helmert → WARNING "datum or projection change", with the PROJ candidate shared with COL-006 and COL-024.

VER-003.logic: Stations added, removed or modified per hole. A change of the desurveyed EOH position > `pos_tol_m` → WARNING; otherwise INFO.

VER-004.title_en: Intervals added, removed, split or merged
VER-004.title_fa: بازه‌های افزوده، حذف، تقسیم یا ادغام‌شده
VER-004.logic: Geometric matching of intervals per hole and table detects splits and merges (one interval ↔ several with the same outer bounds) as well as additions and removals. INFO summary per table. Sampled metres inside mineralised intervals decreasing → WARNING.

VER-005.logic: Per field: count of changed values, absolute and relative magnitude, and direction. A 1:1 (bijective) code substitution across all rows → INFO "renamed code". Assay changes ≥ `upward_share` upward with n ≥ `min_n` (sign test) → WARNING (see ASY-021).

VER-006.title_en: Value changed between versions without a source document or audit reason
VER-006.title_fa: تغییر مقدار بین نسخه‌ها بدون سند منبع یا دلیل ممیزی
VER-006.logic: Each change to a `source_controlled_fields` value (assays, collar x/y/z/eoh_m, survey stations, QC results and statuses) must be backed in the newer version by a new or revised certificate or lab job, a new survey record, or an audit entry (who, when, reason). Unexplained changes and deleted QC failures → ERROR. Changes to records marked approved or locked → WARNING. Summarised by user and date window.
VER-006.parameters: `source_controlled_fields` (profile); numeric tolerance per field (default 0.5 × the reporting step)
VER-006.reference: DBMS audit trails (acQuire, MX Deposit, SABLE); Red Pine (2023) assay-tampering disclosure (RA)
VER-006.status: NEW: acQuire, MX Deposit, SABLE; disclosures (RA)

VER-007.title_en: Reported significant intercepts not reproducible from the database
VER-007.title_fa: عدم بازتولید برخوردهای مهم گزارش‌شده از پایگاه داده
VER-007.logic: ⟦`table:reported_intercept`⟧ (Appendix C), with aggregation parameters (cut-off, maximum internal dilution, minimum width, top-cut, metal-equivalent formula, weighting). Recomputed from the current database with those parameters, matched by hole and overlap. No recomputed intercept with ≥ `overlap_min` overlap → ERROR. |Δfrom| or |Δto| > max(`depth_tol_m`, one sample length) → WARNING. Relative |Δgrade| > `grade_tol_warn` → WARNING; > `grade_tol_err` → ERROR. A reported "true width" with no orientation basis (SPA-005) → INFO. Holes with pending samples (SMP-005) are excluded. Database changes since publication (VER-001 to VER-006) are listed as the likely cause.
VER-007.reference: JORC T1.07 "verification of significant intersections by independent or alternative company personnel" (RC)

VER-008.title_en: Earlier CRITICAL or ERROR issues unresolved or re-appearing
VER-008.title_fa: مسائل بحرانی یا خطای پیشین حل‌نشده یا تکرارشونده
VER-008.logic: Issue fingerprints across `run_id`s. CRITICAL or ERROR issues open in previous runs and still present → WARNING, with their age (runs, days). Open for > `max_runs` runs, or CRITICAL older than `max_days_critical` → ERROR. A fingerprint marked FIXED in an earlier run that re-appears → ERROR "regression: fix overwritten by a re-import". IGNORED without a reason → INFO. Produces the audit close-out table for the report.
VER-008.reference: JORC T1.12 "audits or reviews"; consultant close-out practice (RC)
